growl.name: Growl
growl.long: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.

growth.name: Growth
growth.desc: Raises user's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1; 2 in Sun.
growth.long: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. If the weather is Sun or Intense Sun, this move raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella, this move will only raise the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage, even if the weather is Sun or Intense Sun.

leechseed.name: Leech Seed
leechseed.desc: 1/8 of target's HP is restored to user every turn.
leechseed.long: The Pokemon at the user's position steals 1/8 of the target's maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. If Big Root is held by the recipient, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will continue being leeched. If the target switches out or uses Mortal Spin or Rapid Spin successfully, the effect ends. Grass-type Pokemon are immune to this move on use, but not its effect.

razorleaf.name: Razor Leaf
razorleaf.desc: High critical hit ratio. Hits adjacent foes.
razorleaf.long: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

sleeppowder.name: Sleep Powder
sleeppowder.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

takedown.name: Take Down
takedown.long: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

sweetscent.name: Sweet Scent
sweetscent.long: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 2 stages.

synthesis.name: Synthesis
synthesis.desc: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.
synthesis.long: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Strong Winds or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Heavy Rain, Rain, Sandstorm, or Snow, all rounded half down.

worryseed.name: Worry Seed
worryseed.long: Causes the target's Ability to become Insomnia. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Insomnia, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

doubleedge.name: Double-Edge
doubleedge.long: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

solarbeam.name: Solar Beam
solarbeam.desc: Charges turn 1. Hits turn 2. No charge in sunlight.
solarbeam.long: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Power is halved if the weather is Heavy Rain, Rain, Sandstorm, or Snow and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, the move still requires a turn to charge.

petalblizzard.name: Petal Blizzard
petalblizzard.desc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent Pokemon.

petaldance.name: Petal Dance
petaldance.desc: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.
petaldance.long: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.

ember.name: Ember
ember.long: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

smokescreen.name: Smokescreen
smokescreen.long: Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

dragonbreath.name: Dragon Breath

rage.desc: Raises the user's Attack by 1 if hit during use.
rage.long: Once this move is successfully used, the user's Attack is raised by 1 stage every time it is hit by another Pokemon's attack as long as this move is chosen for use.

tailwhip.long: Lowers the target's Defense by 1 stage.

rapidspin.name: Rapid Spin

bite.name: Bite
bite.desc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
bite.long: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

bubble.name: Bubble
bubble.desc: 10% chance to lower the foe(s) Speed by 1.
bubble.long: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

waterpulse.name: Water Pulse
waterpulse.long: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.

protect.name: Protect
protect.desc: Prevents moves from affecting the user this turn.
protect.long: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

raindance.name: Rain Dance
raindance.desc: For 5 turns, heavy rain powers Water moves.
raindance.long: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Rain. The damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Damp Rock. Fails if the current weather is Rain.

shellsmash.name: Shell Smash

skullbash.long: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage on the first turn. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

wavecrash.long: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

flashcannon.long: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

bugbite.long: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held Berry if it is holding one and eats it immediately, gaining its effects even if the user's item is being ignored. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

harden.name: Harden
harden.long: Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage.

gust.name: Gust
gust.desc: Power doubles during Bounce, Fly, and Sky Drop.
gust.long: Power doubles if the target is using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop.

confusion.name: Confusion

silverwind.desc: 10% chance to raise all stats by 1 (not acc/eva).
silverwind.long: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.desc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.
whirlwind.long: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, or if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability.

safeguard.name: Safeguard
safeguard.desc: For 5 turns, protects user's party from status.
safeguard.long: For 5 turns, the user and its party members cannot have non-volatile status conditions or confusion inflicted on them by other Pokemon. Pokemon on the user's side cannot become affected by Yawn but can fall asleep from its effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Defog. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

bugbuzz.name: Bug Buzz
bugbuzz.desc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.
bugbuzz.long: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

tailwind.name: Tailwind
tailwind.desc: For 4 turns, allies' Speed is doubled.
tailwind.long: For 4 turns, the user and its party members have their Speed doubled. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

captivate.name: Captivate
captivate.desc: Lowers the foe(s) Sp. Atk by 2 if opposite gender.
captivate.long: Lowers the target's Special Attack by 2 stages. The target is unaffected if both the user and the target are the same gender, or if either is genderless. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability are immune.

ragepowder.name: Rage Powder
ragepowder.desc: The foes' moves target the user on the turn used.
ragepowder.long: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from the opposing side are redirected to the user. Such attacks are redirected to the user before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.

quiverdance.name: Quiver Dance
quiverdance.desc: Raises the user's Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, Speed by 1.
quiverdance.long: Raises the user's Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.

poisonsting.name: Poison Sting
poisonsting.long: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

furyattack.name: Fury Attack
furyattack.long: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

twineedle.name: Twineedle
twineedle.desc: Hits 2 times. Each hit has 20% chance to poison.
twineedle.long: Hits twice, with each hit having a 20% chance to poison the target. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

pursuit.name: Pursuit
pursuit.desc: If a foe is switching out, hits it at 2× power.
pursuit.long: If an opposing Pokemon switches out this turn, this move hits that Pokemon before it leaves the field, even if it was not the original target. If the user moves after an opponent using Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch, but not Baton Pass, it will hit that opponent before it leaves the field. Power doubles and no accuracy check is done if the user hits an opponent switching out, and the user's turn is over; if an opponent faints from this, the replacement Pokemon does not become active until the end of the turn.

focusenergy.name: Focus Energy
focusenergy.desc: Raises the user's critical hit ratio by 2.
focusenergy.long: Raises the user's chance for a critical hit by 2 stages. Fails if the user already has the effect. Baton Pass can be used to transfer this effect to an ally.

venoshock.name: Venoshock
venoshock.desc: Power doubles if the target is poisoned.

assurance.name: Assurance
assurance.desc: Power doubles if target was damaged this turn.
assurance.long: Power doubles if the target has already taken damage this turn, other than direct damage from Belly Drum, confusion, Curse, or Pain Split.

toxicspikes.name: Toxic Spikes
toxicspikes.desc: Poisons grounded foes on switch-in. Max 2 layers.
toxicspikes.long: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, poisoning each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to two times before failing. Opposing Pokemon become poisoned with one layer and badly poisoned with two layers. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, is hit by Defog, or a grounded Poison-type Pokemon switches in. Safeguard prevents the opposing party from being poisoned on switch-in, but a substitute does not.

pinmissile.name: Pin Missile
pinmissile.long: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

poisonjab.name: Poison Jab
poisonjab.long: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

agility.name: Agility
agility.long: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages.

endeavor.name: Endeavor
endeavor.desc: Lowers the target's HP to the user's HP.
endeavor.long: Deals damage to the target equal to (target's current HP - user's current HP). The target is unaffected if its current HP is less than or equal to the user's current HP.

fellstinger.name: Fell Stinger
fellstinger.desc: Raises user's Attack by 3 if this KOes the target.
fellstinger.long: Raises the user's Attack by 3 stages if this move knocks out the target.

sandattack.name: Sand Attack
sandattack.long: Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

twister.desc: 20% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.
twister.long: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch. Power doubles if the target is using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop.

featherdance.name: Feather Dance
featherdance.long: Lowers the target's Attack by 2 stages.

roost.name: Roost
roost.desc: Heals 50% HP. Flying-type removed 'til turn ends.
roost.long: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. If the user is not Terastallized, until the end of the turn Flying-type users lose their Flying type and pure Flying-type users become Normal type. Does nothing if the user's HP is full.

mirrormove.name: Mirror Move
mirrormove.desc: User uses the target's last used move against it.
mirrormove.long: The user uses the last move used by the target. The copied move is used against that target, if possible. Fails if the target has not made a move, or if the last move used cannot be copied by this move.

hurricane.name: Hurricane
hurricane.desc: 30% chance to confuse target. Can't miss in rain.
hurricane.long: Has a 30% chance to confuse the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, this move's accuracy is 50%. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.

hyperfang.name: Hyper Fang
hyperfang.desc: 10% chance to make the target flinch.
hyperfang.long: Has a 10% chance to make the target flinch.

crunch.desc: 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.
crunch.long: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

suckerpunch.name: Sucker Punch
suckerpunch.desc: Usually goes first. Fails if target is not attacking.
suckerpunch.long: Fails if the target did not select a physical attack, special attack, or Me First for use this turn, or if the target moves before the user.

superfang.name: Super Fang
superfang.desc: Does damage equal to 1/2 target's current HP.
superfang.long: Deals damage to the target equal to half of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

spitup.long: Power is equal to 100 times the user's Stockpile count. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. Whether or not this move is successful, the user's Defense and Special Defense decrease by as many stages as Stockpile had increased them, and the user's Stockpile count resets to 0.

stockpile.name: Stockpile
stockpile.desc: Raises user's Defense, Sp. Def by 1. Max 3 uses.
stockpile.long: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. The user's Stockpile count increases by 1. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 3. The user's Stockpile count is reset to 0 when it is no longer active.

swallow.name: Swallow
swallow.desc: Heals the user based on uses of Stockpile.
swallow.long: The user restores its HP based on its Stockpile count. Restores 1/4 of its maximum HP if it's 1, 1/2 of its maximum HP if it's 2, both rounded half down, and all of its HP if it's 3. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. The user's Defense and Special Defense decrease by as many stages as Stockpile had increased them, and the user's Stockpile count resets to 0.

acidspray.name: Acid Spray
acidspray.desc: 100% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 2.
acidspray.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.

mudbomb.long: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

sludgebomb.long: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

belch.name: Belch
belch.desc: Cannot be selected until the user eats a Berry.
belch.long: This move cannot be selected until the user eats a Berry, either by eating one that was held, stealing and eating one off another Pokemon with Bug Bite or Pluck, or eating one that was thrown at it with Fling. Once the condition is met, this move can be selected and used for the rest of the battle even if the user gains or uses another item or switches out. Consuming a Berry with Natural Gift does not count for the purposes of eating one.

feint.desc: Nullifies Detect, Protect, and Quick/Wide Guard.
feint.long: If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. lightscreen.long: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5× damage from special attacks, or 0.66× damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. defensecurl.name: Defense Curl
defensecurl.long: Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage. As long as the user remains active, the power of the user's Ice Ball and Rollout will be doubled (this effect is not stackable).

rollout.name: Rollout
rollout.desc: Power doubles with each hit. Repeats for 5 turns.
rollout.long: If this move is successful, the user is locked into this move and cannot make another move until it misses, 5 turns have passed, or the attack cannot be used. Power doubles with each successful hit of this move and doubles again if Defense Curl was used previously by the user. If this move is called by Sleep Talk, the move is used for one turn.

furycutter.name: Fury Cutter
furycutter.desc: Power doubles with each hit, up to 160.
furycutter.long: Power doubles with each successful hit, up to a maximum of 160 power. The power is reset if this move misses or another move is used.

magnitude.name: Magnitude
magnitude.desc: Hits adjacent Pokemon. Power varies; 2× on Dig.
magnitude.long: The power of this move varies; 5% chances for 10 and 150 power, 10% chances for 30 and 110 power, 20% chances for 50 and 90 power, and 30% chance for 70 power. Damage doubles if the target is using Dig.

bulldoze.name: Bulldoze
bulldoze.desc: 100% chance lower adjacent Pkmn Speed by 1.
bulldoze.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

swift.name: Swift
swift.desc: This move does not check accuracy. Hits foes.
swift.long: This move does not check accuracy.

sandtomb.name: Sand Tomb
sandtomb.desc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.
sandtomb.long: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

furyswipes.name: Fury Swipes
furyswipes.long: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

dig.name: Dig
dig.long: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Earthquake and Magnitude but takes double damage from them, and is also unaffected by weather. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

gyroball.name: Gyro Ball
gyroball.desc: More power the slower the user than the target.
gyroball.long: Power is equal to (25 * target's current Speed / user's current Speed) + 1, rounded down, but not more than 150. If the user's current Speed is 0, this move's power is 1.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.desc: For 5 turns, a sandstorm rages. Rock: 1.5× SpD.
sandstorm.long: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Sandstorm. At the end of each turn except the last, all active Pokemon lose 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, unless they are a Ground, Rock, or Steel type, or have the Magic Guard, Overcoat, Sand Force, Sand Rush, or Sand Veil Abilities. During the effect, the Special Defense of Rock-type Pokemon is multiplied by 1.5 when taking damage from a special attack. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Smooth Rock. Fails if the current weather is Sandstorm.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.desc: Hits adjacent Pokemon. Double damage on Dig.
earthquake.long: Damage doubles if the target is using Dig.

crushclaw.name: Crush Claw
crushclaw.desc: 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.
crushclaw.long: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

doublekick.name: Double Kick
doublekick.long: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

helpinghand.name: Helping Hand
helpinghand.desc: One adjacent ally's move power is 1.5× this turn.
helpinghand.long: The power of the target's attack this turn is multiplied by 1.5 (this effect is stackable). Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user or if the ally already moved this turn, but does not fail if the ally is using a two-turn move.

toxic.name: Toxic
toxic.desc: Badly poisons the target. Poison types can't miss.
toxic.long: Badly poisons the target. If a Poison-type Pokemon uses this move, the target cannot avoid the attack, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move.

flatter.name: Flatter
flatter.desc: Raises the target's Sp. Atk by 1 and confuses it.
flatter.long: Raises the target's Special Attack by 1 stage and confuses it.

poisonfang.name: Poison Fang
poisonfang.desc: 50% chance to badly poison the target.
poisonfang.long: Has a 50% chance to badly poison the target.

earthpower.name: Earth Power
earthpower.desc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.
earthpower.long: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

superpower.name: Superpower
superpower.desc: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1.
superpower.long: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.

chipaway.name: Chip Away
chipaway.desc: Ignores the target's stat stage changes.
chipaway.long: Ignores the target's stat stage changes, including evasiveness.

bodyslam.name: Body Slam
bodyslam.long: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

horndrill.name: Horn Drill
horndrill.desc: OHKOs the target. Fails if user is a lower level.
horndrill.long: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.

thrash.name: Thrash
thrash.desc: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.
thrash.long: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.

copycat.name: Copycat
copycat.desc: Uses the last move used in the battle.
copycat.long: The user uses the last move used by any Pokemon, including itself. Fails if no move has been used, or if the last move used was Assist, Baneful Bunker, Beak Blast, Behemoth Bash, Behemoth Blade, Belch, Bestow, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Circle Throw, Combat Torque, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dragon Tail, Dynamax Cannon, Endure, Feint, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, King's Shield, Magical Torque, Mat Block, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Protect, Rage Powder, Roar, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Spiky Shield, Spotlight, Struggle, Switcheroo, Tera Starstorm, Thief, Transform, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wicked Torque.

disarmingvoice.name: Disarming Voice
disarmingvoice.desc: This move does not check accuracy. Hits foes.
disarmingvoice.long: This move does not check accuracy.

sing.name: Sing
sing.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

spotlight.name: Spotlight
spotlight.desc: Target's foes' moves are redirected to it this turn.
spotlight.long: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from opponents of the target are redirected to the target. Such attacks are redirected to the target before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal.

storedpower.name: Stored Power
storedpower.desc: + 20 power for each of the user's stat boosts.
storedpower.long: Power is equal to 20+(X × 20), where X is the user's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0.

encore.name: Encore
encore.desc: Target repeats its last move for its next 3 turns.
encore.long: For its next 3 turns, the target is forced to repeat its last move used. If the affected move runs out of PP, the effect ends. Fails if the target is already under this effect, if it has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if the move is Assist, Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Encore, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Transform, or Wicked Torque.

minimize.name: Minimize
minimize.long: Raises the user's evasiveness by 2 stages. Whether or not the user's evasiveness was changed, Body Slam, Dragon Rush, Flying Press, Heat Crash, Heavy Slam, Malicious Moonsault, Steamroller, Stomp, and Supercell Slam will not check accuracy and have their damage doubled if used against the user while it is active.

doubleslap.name: Double Slap
doubleslap.long: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.

afteryou.name: After You
afteryou.desc: The target makes its move right after the user.
afteryou.long: The target makes its move immediately after the user this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target would have moved next anyway, or if the target already moved this turn.

lifedew.name: Life Dew
lifedew.desc: Heals the user and its allies by 1/4 their max HP.
lifedew.long: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

bestow.name: Bestow
bestow.desc: User passes its held item to the target.
bestow.long: The target receives the user's held item. Fails if the user has no item or is holding a Z-Crystal, if the target is already holding an item, if the item is a Mega Stone and either the user or the target is the species that can Mega Evolve with it, or if the item is a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Griseous Orb, Plate, Drive, or Memory and either the user or the target is a Kyogre, Groudon, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, or Silvally, respectively.

metronome.name: Metronome
metronome.long: A random move is selected for use, other than After You, Apple Acid, Armor Cannon, Assist, Astral Barrage, Aura Wheel, Baneful Bunker, Beak Blast, Behemoth Bash, Behemoth Blade, Belch, Bestow, Blazing Torque, Body Press, Branch Poke, Breaking Swipe, Celebrate, Chatter, Chilling Water, Chilly Reception, Clangorous Soul, Collision Course, Combat Torque, Comeuppance, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Crafty Shield, Decorate, Destiny Bond, Detect, Diamond Storm, Doodle, Double Iron Bash, Double Shock, Dragon Ascent, Dragon Energy, Drum Beating, Dynamax Cannon, Electro Drift, Endure, Eternabeam, False Surrender, Feint, Fiery Wrath, Fillet Away, Fleur Cannon, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Freeze Shock, Freezing Glare, Glacial Lance, Grav Apple, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, Hyper Drill, Hyperspace Fury, Hyperspace Hole, Ice Burn, Instruct, Jet Punch, Jungle Healing, King's Shield, Life Dew, Light of Ruin, Magical Torque, Make It Rain, Mat Block, Me First, Meteor Assault, Metronome, Mimic, Mind Blown, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Moongeist Beam, Nature Power, Nature's Madness, Noxious Torque, Obstruct, Order Up, Origin Pulse, Overdrive, Photon Geyser, Plasma Fists, Population Bomb, Pounce, Power Shift, Precipice Blades, Protect, Pyro Ball, Quash, Quick Guard, Rage Fist, Rage Powder, Raging Bull, Raging Fury, Relic Song, Revival Blessing, Ruination, Salt Cure, Secret Sword, Shed Tail, Shell Trap, Silk Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snap Trap, Snarl, Snatch, Snore, Snowscape, Spectral Thief, Spicy Extract, Spiky Shield, Spirit Break, Spotlight, Springtide Storm, Steam Eruption, Steel Beam, Strange Steam, Struggle, Sunsteel Strike, Surging Strikes, Switcheroo, Techno Blast, Tera Starstorm, Thief, Thousand Arrows, Thousand Waves, Thunder Cage, Thunderous Kick, Tidy Up, Trailblaze, Transform, Trick, Twin Beam, V-create, Wicked Blow, Wicked Torque, or Wide Guard.

wakeupslap.name: Wake-Up Slap
wakeupslap.desc: Power doubles if target is asleep, and wakes it.
wakeupslap.long: Power doubles if the target is asleep. If the user has not fainted, the target wakes up.

moonlight.name: Moonlight
moonlight.desc: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.
moonlight.long: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Strong Winds or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Heavy Rain, Rain, Sandstorm, or Snow, all rounded half down.

gravity.name: Gravity
gravity.long: For 5 turns, the evasiveness of all active Pokemon is multiplied by 0.6. At the time of use, Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, and Telekinesis end immediately for all active Pokemon. During the effect, Bounce, Fly, Flying Press, High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, Splash, and Telekinesis are prevented from being used by all active Pokemon. Ground-type attacks, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability can affect Flying types or Pokemon with the Levitate Ability. Fails if this move is already in effect.

meteormash.name: Meteor Mash
meteormash.desc: 20% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1.
meteormash.long: Has a 20% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1 stage.

followme.name: Follow Me
followme.desc: The foes' moves target the user on the turn used.
followme.long: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from the opposing side are redirected to the user. Such attacks are redirected to the user before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.

luckychant.name: Lucky Chant
luckychant.desc: For 5 turns, shields user's party from critical hits.
luckychant.long: For 5 turns, the user and its party members cannot be struck by a critical hit. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

cosmicpower.name: Cosmic Power
cosmicpower.desc: Raises the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.
cosmicpower.long: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

moonblast.name: Moonblast
moonblast.desc: 30% chance to lower the target's Sp. Atk by 1.
moonblast.long: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

healingwish.name: Healing Wish
healingwish.desc: User faints. Next hurt Pokemon is fully healed.
healingwish.long: The user faints, and if the Pokemon brought out to replace it does not have full HP or has a non-volatile status condition, its HP is fully restored along with having any non-volatile status condition cured. The replacement is sent out at the end of the turn, and the healing happens before hazards take effect. This effect continues until a Pokemon that meets either of these conditions switches in at the user's position or gets swapped into the position with Ally Switch. Fails if the user is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party.

disable.name: Disable
disable.desc: For 4 turns, disables the target's last move used.
disable.long: For 4 turns, the target's last move used becomes disabled. Fails if one of the target's moves is already disabled, if the target has not made a move, if the target no longer knows the move, or if the move was a Max or G-Max Move.

roar.name: Roar
roar.desc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.
roar.long: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, or if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability.

babydolleyes.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
babydolleyes.long: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.

spite.name: Spite
spite.desc: Lowers the PP of the target's last move by 4.
spite.long: Causes the target's last move used to lose 4 PP. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if it no longer knows the move.

incinerate.name: Incinerate
incinerate.long: The target loses its held item if it is a Berry or a Gem. This move cannot cause Pokemon with the Sticky Hold Ability to lose their held item. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

payback.name: Payback
payback.desc: Power doubles if the user moves after the target.
payback.long: Power doubles if the user moves after the target this turn, including actions taken through Instruct or the Dancer Ability. Switching in does not count as an action.

confuseray.name: Confuse Ray
confuseray.long: Causes the target to become confused.

feintattack.name: Feint Attack
feintattack.desc: This move does not check accuracy.

hex.name: Hex
hex.desc: Power doubles if the target has a status ailment.
hex.long: Power doubles if the target has a non-volatile status condition.

extrasensory.name: Extrasensory
extrasensory.desc: 10% chance to make the target flinch.
extrasensory.long: Has a 10% chance to make the target flinch.

imprison.name: Imprison
imprison.desc: No foe can use any move known by the user.
imprison.long: The user prevents all opposing Pokemon from using any moves that the user also knows as long as the user remains active.

fireblast.name: Fire Blast
fireblast.long: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

grudge.name: Grudge
grudge.desc: If the user faints, the attack used loses all its PP.
grudge.long: Until the user's next turn, if an opposing Pokemon's attack knocks the user out, that move loses all its remaining PP.

echoedvoice.name: Echoed Voice
echoedvoice.desc: Power increases when used on consecutive turns.
echoedvoice.long: For every consecutive turn that this move is used by at least one Pokemon, this move's power is multiplied by the number of turns to pass, but not more than 5.

covet.name: Covet
covet.desc: If the user has no item, it steals the target's.
covet.long: If this attack was successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held item if the user is not holding one. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask held by a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon, respectively, or if the user is one of those species and the target is holding the respective item. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

round.name: Round
round.desc: Power doubles if others used Round this turn.
round.long: If there are other active Pokemon that chose this move for use this turn, those Pokemon take their turn immediately after the user, in Speed order, and this move's power is 120 for each other user.

rest.name: Rest
rest.desc: User sleeps 2 turns and restores HP and status.
rest.long: The user falls asleep for the next two turns and restores all of its HP, curing itself of any non-volatile status condition in the process. Fails if the user has full HP, is already asleep, or if another effect is preventing sleep.

mimic.name: Mimic
mimic.desc: The last move the target used replaces this one.
mimic.long: While the user remains active, this move is replaced by the last move used by the target. The copied move has the maximum PP for that move. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the user has Transformed, if the user already knows the move, or if the move is Assist, Behemoth Bash, Behemoth Blade, Belch, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Hold Hands, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Tera Starstorm, Transform, or Wicked Torque.

hypervoice.name: Hyper Voice
hypervoice.desc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

playrough.name: Play Rough
playrough.desc: 10% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.
playrough.long: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

absorb.name: Absorb
absorb.desc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.
absorb.long: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

astonish.name: Astonish
astonish.desc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
astonish.long: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

meanlook.name: Mean Look
meanlook.desc: Prevents the target from switching out.
meanlook.long: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

quickguard.name: Quick Guard
quickguard.desc: Protects allies from priority attacks this turn.
quickguard.long: The user and its party members are protected from attacks with original or altered priority greater than 0 made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

aircutter.name: Air Cutter
aircutter.desc: High critical hit ratio. Hits adjacent foes.
aircutter.long: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
acrobatics.desc: Power doubles if the user has no held item.

leechlife.name: Leech Life
leechlife.desc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.
leechlife.long: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

megadrain.name: Mega Drain
megadrain.desc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.
megadrain.long: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

gigadrain.name: Giga Drain
gigadrain.desc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.
gigadrain.long: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

grassyterrain.name: Grassy Terrain
grassyterrain.long: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Grassy Terrain. During the effect, the power of Grass-type attacks used by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3, the power of Bulldoze, Earthquake, and Magnitude used against grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 0.5, and grounded Pokemon have 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, restored at the end of each turn, including the last turn. Camouflage transforms the user into a Grass type, Nature Power becomes Energy Ball, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to cause sleep. Fails if the current terrain is Grassy Terrain.

naturalgift.name: Natural Gift
naturalgift.desc: Power and type depends on the user's Berry.
naturalgift.long: The type and power of this move depend on the user's held Berry, and the Berry is lost. Fails if the user is not holding a Berry, if the user has the Klutz Ability, or if Embargo or Magic Room is in effect for the user.

aromatherapy.name: Aromatherapy
aromatherapy.desc: Cures the user's party of all status conditions.
aromatherapy.long: Every Pokemon in the user's party is cured of its non-volatile status condition. Active Pokemon with the Sap Sipper Ability are not cured, unless they are the user.

spore.name: Spore
spore.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

crosspoison.name: Cross Poison
crosspoison.desc: High critical hit ratio. 10% chance to poison.
crosspoison.long: Has a 10% chance to poison the target and a higher chance for a critical hit.

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.desc: Fighting, Normal hit Ghost. Evasiveness ignored.
foresight.long: As long as the target remains active, its evasiveness stat stage is ignored during accuracy checks against it if it is greater than 0, and Normal- and Fighting-type attacks can hit the target if it is a Ghost type. Fails if the target is already affected, or affected by Miracle Eye or Odor Sleuth.

signalbeam.name: Signal Beam
signalbeam.long: Has a 10% chance to confuse the target.

zenheadbutt.name: Zen Headbutt
zenheadbutt.desc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.
zenheadbutt.long: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.

psychic.name: Psychic
psychic.desc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.
psychic.long: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

mudslap.name: Mud-Slap
mudslap.desc: 100% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.
mudslap.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

fissure.name: Fissure
fissure.desc: OHKOs the target. Fails if user is a lower level.
fissure.long: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.

nightslash.name: Night Slash
nightslash.long: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

rototiller.name: Rototiller
rototiller.desc: Raises Atk/Sp. Atk of grounded Grass types by 1.
rototiller.long: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of all grounded Grass-type Pokemon on the field by 1 stage.

triattack.name: Tri Attack
triattack.desc: 20% chance to paralyze or burn or freeze target.
triattack.long: Has a 20% chance to either burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

fakeout.name: Fake Out
fakeout.desc: Hits first. First turn out only. 100% flinch chance.
fakeout.long: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.desc: Target can't use status moves its next 3 turns.
taunt.long: Prevents the target from using non-damaging moves for its next three turns. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.

swagger.name: Swagger
swagger.desc: Raises the target's Attack by 2 and confuses it.
swagger.long: Raises the target's Attack by 2 stages and confuses it.

switcheroo.name: Switcheroo
switcheroo.desc: User switches its held item with the target's.
switcheroo.long: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if both the user and the target have no held item, or if the user is trying to give or take a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask to or from a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon, respectively. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.

watersport.name: Water Sport
watersport.desc: For 5 turns, Fire-type attacks have 1/3 power.
watersport.long: For 5 turns, all Fire-type attacks used by any active Pokemon have their power multiplied by 0.33. Fails if this effect is already active.

soak.name: Soak
soak.desc: Changes the target's type to Water.
soak.long: Causes the target to become a Water type. Fails if the target is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the target is already purely Water type, or if the target is Terastallized.

psychup.name: Psych Up
psychup.desc: Copies the target's current stat stages.
psychup.long: The user copies all of the target's current stat stage changes.

amnesia.name: Amnesia
amnesia.desc: Raises the user's Sp. Def by 2.
amnesia.long: Raises the user's Special Defense by 2 stages.

wonderroom.name: Wonder Room
wonderroom.desc: For 5 turns, all Defense and Sp. Def stats switch.
wonderroom.long: For 5 turns, all active Pokemon have their Defense and Special Defense stats swapped. Stat stage changes are unaffected. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

mefirst.name: Me First
mefirst.desc: Copies a foe at 1.5× power. User must be faster.
mefirst.long: The user uses the move the target chose for use this turn against it, if possible, with its power multiplied by 1.5. The move must be a damaging move other than Beak Blast, Belch, Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Comeuppance, Counter, Covet, Focus Punch, Magical Torque, Me First, Metal Burst, Mirror Coat, Noxious Torque, Shell Trap, Struggle, Thief, or Wicked Torque. Fails if the target moves before the user. Ignores the target's substitute for the purpose of copying the move.

karatechop.name: Karate Chop
karatechop.long: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

lowkick.name: Low Kick
lowkick.desc: More power the heavier the target.
lowkick.long: This move's power is 20 if the target weighs less than 10 kg, 40 if less than 25 kg, 60 if less than 50 kg, 80 if less than 100 kg, 100 if less than 200 kg, and 120 if greater than or equal to 200 kg.

seismictoss.name: Seismic Toss
seismictoss.desc: Does damage equal to the user's level.
seismictoss.long: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's level.

crosschop.name: Cross Chop
crosschop.long: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

punishment.name: Punishment
punishment.desc: 60 power +20 for each of the target's stat boosts.
punishment.long: Power is equal to 60+(X × 20), where X is the target's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0, but not more than 200 power.

closecombat.name: Close Combat
closecombat.desc: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.
closecombat.long: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

stompingtantrum.name: Stomping Tantrum
stompingtantrum.desc: Power doubles if the user's last move failed.
stompingtantrum.long: Power doubles if the user's last move on the previous turn, including moves called by other moves or those used through Instruct, Magic Coat, Snatch, or the Dancer or Magic Bounce Abilities, failed to do any of its normal effects, not including damage from an unsuccessful High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, or Mind Blown, or if the user was prevented from moving by any effect other than recharging or Sky Drop. A move that was blocked by Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, Spiky Shield, Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard will not double this move's power, nor will Bounce or Fly ending early due to the effect of Gravity, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows.

outrage.name: Outrage
outrage.desc: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.
outrage.long: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.

finalgambit.name: Final Gambit
finalgambit.desc: Does damage equal to the user's HP. User faints.
finalgambit.long: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's current HP. If this move is successful, the user faints.

fling.name: Fling
fling.desc: Flings the user's item at the target. Power varies.
fling.long: The power of this move is based on the user's held item. The held item is lost and it activates for the target if applicable. If there is no target or the target avoids this move by protecting itself, the user's held item is still lost. The user can regain a thrown item with Recycle or the Harvest Ability. Fails if the user has no held item, if the held item cannot be thrown, if the user is under the effect of Embargo or Magic Room, or if the user has the Klutz Ability.

ragefist.name: Rage Fist
ragefist.desc: +50 power for each time user was hit. Max 6 hits.
ragefist.long: Power is equal to 50+(X × 50), where X is the total number of times the user has been hit by a damaging attack during the battle, even if the user did not lose HP from the attack. X cannot be greater than 6 and does not reset upon switching out or fainting. Each hit of a multi-hit attack is counted, but confusion damage is not counted.

howl.name: Howl
howl.desc: Raises the user's and ally's Attack by 1.
howl.long: Raises the Attack of the user and all allies 1 stage.

odorsleuth.name: Odor Sleuth
odorsleuth.desc: Fighting, Normal hit Ghost. Evasiveness ignored.
odorsleuth.long: As long as the target remains active, its evasiveness stat stage is ignored during accuracy checks against it if it is greater than 0, and Normal- and Fighting-type attacks can hit the target if it is a Ghost type. Fails if the target is already affected, or affected by Foresight or Miracle Eye.

flamewheel.name: Flame Wheel
flamewheel.desc: 10% chance to burn the target. Thaws user.
flamewheel.long: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

retaliate.name: Retaliate
retaliate.desc: Power doubles if an ally fainted last turn.
retaliate.long: Power doubles if one of the user's party members fainted last turn.

reversal.name: Reversal
reversal.desc: More power the less HP the user has left.
reversal.long: The power of this move is 20 if X is 33 to 48, 40 if X is 17 to 32, 80 if X is 10 to 16, 100 if X is 5 to 9, 150 if X is 2 to 4, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP × 48 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.

burnup.name: Burn Up
burnup.desc: User's Fire type becomes typeless; must be Fire.
burnup.long: Fails unless the user is a Fire type. If this move is successful and the user is not Terastallized, the user's Fire type becomes typeless as long as it remains active.

hypnosis.name: Hypnosis
hypnosis.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

mudshot.name: Mud Shot
mudshot.desc: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.
mudshot.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

bubblebeam.name: Bubble Beam
bubblebeam.desc: 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.
bubblebeam.long: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

bellydrum.name: Belly Drum
bellydrum.desc: User loses 50% max HP. Maximizes Attack.
bellydrum.long: Raises the user's Attack by 12 stages in exchange for the user losing 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack stat stage is 6.

circlethrow.name: Circle Throw
circlethrow.desc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.
circlethrow.long: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target is under the effect of Ingrain, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.

dynamicpunch.name: Dynamic Punch
dynamicpunch.long: Has a 100% chance to confuse the target.

mindreader.name: Mind Reader
mindreader.desc: User's next move will not miss the target.
mindreader.long: Until the end of the next turn, the target cannot avoid the user's moves, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field. Fails if this effect is active for the user.

submission.name: Submission
submission.long: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.long: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members.

kinesis.name: Kinesis
kinesis.long: Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

reflect.name: Reflect
reflect.desc: For 5 turns, physical damage to allies is halved.
reflect.long: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5× damage from physical attacks, or 0.66× damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

allyswitch.name: Ally Switch
allyswitch.desc: User and ally swap positions; using again can fail.
allyswitch.long: The user swaps positions with its ally. Fails if the user is the only Pokemon on its side. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails or if the user's last move used is not Ally Switch.

psychocut.name: Psycho Cut
psychocut.long: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

miracleeye.name: Miracle Eye
miracleeye.long: As long as the target remains active, its evasiveness stat stage is ignored during accuracy checks against it if it is greater than 0, and Psychic-type attacks can hit the target if it is a Dark type. Fails if the target is already affected, or affected by Foresight or Odor Sleuth.

recover.name: Recover
recover.desc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.
recover.long: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

psyshock.name: Psyshock
psyshock.desc: Damages target based on Defense, not Sp. Def.
psyshock.long: Deals damage to the target based on its Defense instead of Special Defense.

telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
telekinesis.desc: For 3 turns, target floats but moves can't miss it.
telekinesis.long: For 3 turns, the target cannot avoid any attacks made against it, other than OHKO moves, as long as it remains active. During the effect, the target is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will gain the effect. Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball override this move if the target is under any of their effects. Fails if the target is already under this effect or the effects of Ingrain, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows. The target is immune to this move on use if its species is Diglett, Dugtrio, Alolan Diglett, Alolan Dugtrio, Sandygast, Palossand, or Gengar while Mega-Evolved. Mega Gengar cannot be under this effect by any means.

roleplay.name: Role Play
roleplay.desc: User replaces its Ability with the target's.
roleplay.long: The user's Ability changes to match the target's Ability. Fails if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, Zero to Hero, or already matches the target, or if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

futuresight.name: Future Sight
futuresight.desc: Hits two turns after being used.
futuresight.long: Deals damage two turns after this move is used. At the end of that turn, the damage is calculated at that time and dealt to the Pokemon at the position the target had when the move was used. If the user is no longer active at the time, damage is calculated based on the user's natural Special Attack stat, types, and level, with no boosts from its held item or Ability. Fails if this move or Doom Desire is already in effect for the target's position.

trick.name: Trick
trick.desc: User switches its held item with the target's.
trick.long: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if both the user and the target have no held item, or if the user is trying to give or take a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask to or from a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon, respectively. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.

calmmind.name: Calm Mind
calmmind.desc: Raises the user's Sp. Atk and Sp. Def by 1.
calmmind.long: Raises the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage.

revenge.name: Revenge
revenge.desc: Power doubles if user is damaged by the target.
revenge.long: Power doubles if the user was hit by the target this turn.

lowsweep.name: Low Sweep
lowsweep.desc: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.
lowsweep.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

knockoff.name: Knock Off
knockoff.desc: 1.5× damage if foe holds an item. Removes item.
knockoff.long: This move's power is multiplied by 1.5 if the target is holding an item, and the target loses its held item if the user has not fainted. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. This move does not increase in power or remove the target's item if it is a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask held by a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon, respectively, or if the user is one of those species and the target is holding the respective item. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

vitalthrow.name: Vital Throw
vitalthrow.desc: This move does not check accuracy. Goes last.
vitalthrow.long: This move does not check accuracy.

dualchop.name: Dual Chop
dualchop.long: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

bulkup.name: Bulk Up
bulkup.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1.
bulkup.long: Raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.

wideguard.name: Wide Guard
wideguard.desc: Protects allies from multi-target moves this turn.
wideguard.long: The user and its party members are protected from moves made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn that target all adjacent foes or all adjacent Pokemon. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

wringout.name: Wring Out
wringout.desc: More power the more HP the target has left.
wringout.long: Power is equal to 120 × (target's current HP / target's maximum HP), rounded half down, but not less than 1.

leafstorm.name: Leaf Storm
leafstorm.desc: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.
leafstorm.long: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.

leaftornado.name: Leaf Tornado
leaftornado.desc: 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.
leaftornado.long: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

leafblade.name: Leaf Blade
leafblade.long: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

constrict.name: Constrict
constrict.desc: 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.
constrict.long: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

barrier.name: Barrier
barrier.long: Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.

acidarmor.name: Acid Armor
acidarmor.long: Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.

brine.name: Brine
brine.desc: Power doubles if the target's HP is 50% or less.
brine.long: Power doubles if the target has less than or equal to half of its maximum HP remaining.

surf.name: Surf
surf.desc: Hits adjacent Pokemon. Double damage on Dive.
surf.long: Damage doubles if the target is using Dive.

sludgewave.name: Sludge Wave
sludgewave.long: Has a 10% chance to poison the target.

reflecttype.name: Reflect Type
reflecttype.desc: User becomes the same type as the target.
reflecttype.long: Causes the user's types to become the same as the current types of the target. If the target's current types include typeless and a non-added type, typeless is ignored. If the target's current types include typeless and an added type from Forest's Curse or Trick-or-Treat, typeless is copied as the Normal type instead. Fails if the user is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the user is Terastallized, or if the target's current type is typeless alone.

mudsport.name: Mud Sport
mudsport.desc: For 5 turns, Electric-type attacks have 1/3 power.
mudsport.long: For 5 turns, all Electric-type attacks used by any active Pokemon have their power multiplied by 0.33. Fails if this effect is already active.

rockpolish.name: Rock Polish
rockpolish.long: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages.

smackdown.name: Smack Down
smackdown.long: This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If this move hits a target under the effect of Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, the effect ends. If the target is a Flying type that has not used Roost this turn or a Pokemon with the Levitate Ability, it loses its immunity to Ground-type attacks and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. During the effect, Magnet Rise fails for the target and Telekinesis fails against the target.

selfdestruct.name: Self-Destruct
selfdestruct.desc: Hits adjacent Pokemon. The user faints.
selfdestruct.long: The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.

stealthrock.name: Stealth Rock
stealthrock.desc: Hurts foes on switch-in. Factors Rock weakness.
stealthrock.long: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in. Fails if the effect is already active on the opposing side. Foes lose 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, 1/4, or 1/2 of their maximum HP, rounded down, based on their weakness to the Rock type; 0.25×, 0.5×, neutral, 2×, or 4×, respectively. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

rockblast.name: Rock Blast
rockblast.long: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

explosion.name: Explosion
explosion.desc: Hits adjacent Pokemon. The user faints.
explosion.long: The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.

stoneedge.name: Stone Edge
stoneedge.long: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

heavyslam.name: Heavy Slam
heavyslam.desc: More power the heavier the user than the target.
heavyslam.long: The power of this move depends on (user's weight / target's weight), rounded down. Power is equal to 120 if the result is 5 or more, 100 if 4, 80 if 3, 60 if 2, and 40 if 1 or less. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

steamroller.name: Steamroller
steamroller.desc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
steamroller.long: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

flamecharge.name: Flame Charge
flamecharge.desc: 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1.
flamecharge.long: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.

stomp.name: Stomp
stomp.desc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
stomp.long: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

bounce.name: Bounce
bounce.long: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister, and Gust and Twister have doubled power when used against it. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

smartstrike.name: Smart Strike
smartstrike.desc: This move does not check accuracy.

curse.name: Curse
curse.desc: Curses if Ghost, else -1 Spe, +1 Atk, +1 Def.
curse.long: If the user is not a Ghost type, lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage and raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. If the user is a Ghost type, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down and even if it would cause fainting, in exchange for the target losing 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn while it is active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will continue to be affected. Fails if there is no target or if the target is already affected.

yawn.name: Yawn
yawn.desc: Puts the target to sleep after 1 turn.
yawn.long: Causes the target to fall asleep at the end of the next turn. Fails when used if the target cannot fall asleep or if it already has a non-volatile status condition. At the end of the next turn, if the target is still active, does not have a non-volatile status condition, and can fall asleep, it falls asleep. If the target becomes affected, this effect cannot be prevented by Safeguard or a substitute, or by falling asleep and waking up during the effect.

headbutt.name: Headbutt
headbutt.desc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
headbutt.long: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

slackoff.name: Slack Off
slackoff.desc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.
slackoff.long: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

healpulse.name: Heal Pulse
healpulse.desc: Heals the target by 50% of its max HP.
healpulse.long: The target restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. If the user has the Mega Launcher Ability, the target instead restores 3/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half down.

magnetbomb.name: Magnet Bomb
magnetbomb.desc: This move does not check accuracy.

sonicboom.name: Sonic Boom
sonicboom.long: Deals 20 HP of damage to the target.

mirrorshot.name: Mirror Shot
mirrorshot.desc: 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.
mirrorshot.long: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

magnetrise.name: Magnet Rise
magnetrise.desc: For 5 turns, the user has immunity to Ground.
magnetrise.long: For 5 turns, the user is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will gain the effect. Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball override this move if the user is under any of their effects. Fails if the user is already under this effect or the effects of Ingrain, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows.

metalsound.name: Metal Sound
metalsound.desc: Lowers the target's Sp. Def by 2.
metalsound.long: Lowers the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.

lockon.name: Lock-On
lockon.desc: User's next move will not miss the target.
lockon.long: Until the end of the next turn, the target cannot avoid the user's moves, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field. Fails if this effect is active for the user.

zapcannon.name: Zap Cannon
zapcannon.long: Has a 100% chance to paralyze the target.

electricterrain.name: Electric Terrain
electricterrain.long: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Electric Terrain. During the effect, the power of Electric-type attacks made by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3 and grounded Pokemon cannot fall asleep; Pokemon already asleep do not wake up. Grounded Pokemon cannot become affected by Yawn or fall asleep from its effect. Camouflage transforms the user into an Electric type, Nature Power becomes Thunderbolt, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to cause paralysis. Fails if the current terrain is Electric Terrain.

falseswipe.name: False Swipe
falseswipe.desc: Always leaves the target with at least 1 HP.
falseswipe.long: Leaves the target with at least 1 HP.

bravebird.name: Brave Bird
bravebird.long: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

doublehit.name: Double Hit
doublehit.long: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

uproar.name: Uproar
uproar.desc: Lasts 3 turns. Active Pokemon cannot fall asleep.
uproar.long: The user spends three turns locked into this move. This move targets an opponent at random on each turn. On the first of the three turns, all sleeping active Pokemon wake up. During the three turns, no active Pokemon can fall asleep by any means, and Pokemon switched in during the effect do not wake up. If the user is prevented from moving or the attack is not successful against the target during one of the turns, the effect ends.

acupressure.name: Acupressure
acupressure.desc: Raises a random stat of the user or an ally by 2.
acupressure.long: Raises a random stat by 2 stages as long as the stat is not already at stage 6. The user can choose to use this move on itself or an adjacent ally. Fails if no stat stage can be raised or if used on an ally with a substitute.

jumpkick.name: Jump Kick
jumpkick.desc: User is hurt by 50% of its max HP if it misses.
jumpkick.long: If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage.

icywind.name: Icy Wind
icywind.desc: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Speed by 1.
icywind.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

aquaring.name: Aqua Ring
aquaring.desc: User recovers 1/16 max HP per turn.
aquaring.long: The user has 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, restored at the end of each turn while it remains active. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will receive the healing effect.

aurorabeam.name: Aurora Beam
aurorabeam.desc: 10% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.
aurorabeam.long: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

dive.name: Dive
dive.long: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Surf and Whirlpool but takes double damage from them, and is also unaffected by weather. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

icebeam.name: Ice Beam
icebeam.long: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

hail.name: Hail
hail.long: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Hail. At the end of each turn except the last, all active Pokemon lose 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, unless they are an Ice type or have the Ice Body, Magic Guard, Overcoat, or Snow Cloak Abilities. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Icy Rock. Fails if the current weather is Hail.

snowscape.name: Snowscape
snowscape.desc: For 5 turns, snow falls. Ice: 1.5× Def.
snowscape.long: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Snow. During the effect, the Defense of Ice-type Pokemon is multiplied by 1.5 when taking damage from a physical attack. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Icy Rock. Fails if the current weather is Snow.

sheercold.name: Sheer Cold
sheercold.desc: OHKOs non-Ice targets. Fails if user's lower level.
sheercold.long: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + X)%, where X is 30 if the user is an Ice type and 20 otherwise, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Ice-type Pokemon and Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.

sludge.name: Sludge
sludge.long: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

memento.name: Memento
memento.desc: Lowers target's Attack, Sp. Atk by 2. User faints.
memento.long: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages. The user faints unless this move misses or there is no target. Fails entirely if this move hits a substitute, but does not fail if the target's stats cannot be changed.

venomdrench.name: Venom Drench
venomdrench.desc: Lowers Atk/Sp. Atk/Speed of poisoned foes by 1.
venomdrench.long: Lowers the target's Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by 1 stage if the target is poisoned. Fails if the target is not poisoned.

iciclespear.name: Icicle Spear
iciclespear.long: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
whirlpool.desc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.
whirlpool.long: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

clamp.name: Clamp
clamp.desc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.
clamp.long: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

razorshell.name: Razor Shell
razorshell.desc: 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.
razorshell.long: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

iciclecrash.name: Icicle Crash
iciclecrash.desc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
iciclecrash.long: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

spikes.name: Spikes
spikes.desc: Hurts grounded foes on switch-in. Max 3 layers.
spikes.long: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to three times before failing. Opponents lose 1/8 of their maximum HP with one layer, 1/6 of their maximum HP with two layers, and 1/4 of their maximum HP with three layers, all rounded down. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

spikecannon.name: Spike Cannon
spikecannon.long: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.

lick.name: Lick
lick.long: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

nightshade.name: Night Shade
nightshade.desc: Does damage equal to the user's level.
nightshade.long: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's level.

darkpulse.name: Dark Pulse
darkpulse.desc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.
darkpulse.long: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.

shadowball.name: Shadow Ball
