shadowball.desc: 20% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.
shadowball.long: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

destinybond.name: Destiny Bond
destinybond.desc: If an opponent knocks out the user, it also faints.
destinybond.long: Until the user's next move, if an opposing Pokemon's attack knocks the user out, that Pokemon faints as well, unless the attack was Doom Desire or Future Sight. Fails if the user used this move successfully as its last move, disregarding moves used through the Dancer Ability.

nightmare.name: Nightmare
nightmare.desc: A sleeping target is hurt by 1/4 max HP per turn.
nightmare.long: Causes the target to lose 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn as long as it is asleep. This move does not affect the target unless it is asleep. The effect ends when the target wakes up, even if it falls asleep again in the same turn.

dreameater.name: Dream Eater
dreameater.desc: User gains 1/2 HP inflicted. Sleeping target only.
dreameater.long: The target is unaffected by this move unless it is asleep. The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

shadowpunch.name: Shadow Punch
shadowpunch.desc: This move does not check accuracy.

perishsong.name: Perish Song
perishsong.desc: All active Pokemon will faint in 3 turns.
perishsong.long: Each active Pokemon receives a perish count of 4 if it doesn't already have a perish count. At the end of each turn including the turn used, the perish count of all active Pokemon lowers by 1 and Pokemon faint if the number reaches 0. The perish count is removed from Pokemon that switch out. If a Pokemon uses Baton Pass while it has a perish count, the replacement will gain the perish count and continue to count down.

bind.name: Bind
bind.desc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.
bind.long: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

rocktomb.name: Rock Tomb
rocktomb.desc: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.
rocktomb.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

rockslide.name: Rock Slide
rockslide.desc: 30% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.
rockslide.long: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

meditate.name: Meditate
meditate.long: Raises the user's Attack by 1 stage.

synchronoise.name: Synchronoise
synchronoise.desc: Hits adjacent Pokemon sharing the user's type.
synchronoise.long: The target is immune if it does not share a type with the user.

flail.name: Flail
flail.desc: More power the less HP the user has left.
flail.long: The power of this move is 20 if X is 33 to 48, 40 if X is 17 to 32, 80 if X is 10 to 16, 100 if X is 5 to 9, 150 if X is 2 to 4, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP × 48 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.

crabhammer.name: Crabhammer
crabhammer.long: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

guillotine.name: Guillotine
guillotine.desc: OHKOs the target. Fails if user is a lower level.
guillotine.long: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.

hammerarm.name: Hammer Arm
hammerarm.long: Lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage.

charge.name: Charge
charge.desc: +1 SpD, user's next Electric move 2× power.
charge.long: Raises the user's Special Defense by 1 stage. The user's next Electric-type attack will have its power doubled; the effect ends when the user is no longer active, or after the user attempts to use any Electric-type move besides Charge, even if it is not successful.

eerieimpulse.name: Eerie Impulse
eerieimpulse.desc: Lowers the target's Sp. Atk by 2.
eerieimpulse.long: Lowers the target's Special Attack by 2 stages.

chargebeam.name: Charge Beam
chargebeam.desc: 70% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1.
chargebeam.long: Has a 70% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.

mirrorcoat.name: Mirror Coat
mirrorcoat.desc: If hit by special attack, returns double damage.
mirrorcoat.long: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a special attack this turn equal to twice the HP lost by the user from that attack. If the user did not lose HP from the attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's special attack this turn.

magneticflux.name: Magnetic Flux
magneticflux.desc: Raises Def, Sp. Def of allies with Plus/Minus by 1.
magneticflux.long: Raises the Defense and Special Defense of Pokemon on the user's side with the Plus or Minus Abilities by 1 stage.

barrage.name: Barrage
barrage.long: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.

bulletseed.name: Bullet Seed
bulletseed.long: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

woodhammer.name: Wood Hammer
woodhammer.long: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

boneclub.name: Bone Club
boneclub.desc: 10% chance to make the target flinch.
boneclub.long: Has a 10% chance to make the target flinch.

bonerush.name: Bone Rush
bonerush.long: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

bonemerang.name: Bonemerang
bonemerang.long: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

brickbreak.name: Brick Break
brickbreak.desc: Destroys screens, unless the target is immune.
brickbreak.long: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated.

rollingkick.name: Rolling Kick
rollingkick.desc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
rollingkick.long: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

endure.name: Endure
endure.desc: User survives attacks this turn with at least 1 HP.
endure.long: The user will survive attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn with at least 1 HP. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

blazekick.name: Blaze Kick
blazekick.desc: High critical hit ratio. 10% chance to burn.
blazekick.long: Has a 10% chance to burn the target and a higher chance for a critical hit.

highjumpkick.name: High Jump Kick
highjumpkick.desc: User is hurt by 50% of its max HP if it misses.
highjumpkick.long: If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage.

axekick.name: Axe Kick
axekick.desc: 30% confusion. User loses 50% max HP if miss.
axekick.long: Has a 30% chance to confuse the target. If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage.

cometpunch.name: Comet Punch
cometpunch.long: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times.

drainpunch.name: Drain Punch
drainpunch.desc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.
drainpunch.long: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

poweruppunch.name: Power-Up Punch
poweruppunch.desc: 100% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1.
poweruppunch.long: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Attack by 1 stage.

detect.name: Detect
detect.desc: Prevents moves from affecting the user this turn.
detect.long: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

firepunch.name: Fire Punch
firepunch.long: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

icepunch.name: Ice Punch
icepunch.long: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

counter.name: Counter
counter.desc: If hit by physical attack, returns double damage.
counter.long: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical attack this turn equal to twice the HP lost by the user from that attack. If the user did not lose HP from the attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical attack this turn.

skyuppercut.name: Sky Uppercut
skyuppercut.desc: Can hit Pokemon using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop.
skyuppercut.long: This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop.

focuspunch.name: Focus Punch
focuspunch.desc: Fails if the user takes damage before it hits.
focuspunch.long: The user loses its focus and does nothing if it is hit by a damaging attack this turn before it can execute the move.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.desc: User cures its burn, poison, or paralysis.
refresh.long: The user cures its burn, poison, or paralysis. Fails if the user is not burned, poisoned, or paralyzed.

smog.name: Smog
smog.long: Has a 40% chance to poison the target.

clearsmog.name: Clear Smog
clearsmog.desc: Resets all of the target's stat stages to 0.

softboiled.name: Soft-Boiled
softboiled.desc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.
softboiled.long: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

lastresort.name: Last Resort
lastresort.desc: Fails unless each known move has been used.
lastresort.long: This move fails unless the user knows this move and at least one other move, and has used all the other moves it knows at least once each since it became active or Transformed.

ancientpower.name: Ancient Power
ancientpower.desc: 10% chance to raise all stats by 1 (not acc/eva).
ancientpower.long: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.

tickle.name: Tickle
tickle.desc: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1.
tickle.long: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.

ingrain.name: Ingrain
ingrain.desc: Traps/grounds user; heals 1/16 max HP per turn.
ingrain.long: The user has 1/16 of its maximum HP restored at the end of each turn, but it is prevented from switching out and other Pokemon cannot force the user to switch out. The user can still switch out if it uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. If the user leaves the field using Baton Pass, the replacement will remain trapped and still receive the healing effect. During the effect, the user can be hit normally by Ground-type attacks and be affected by Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web, even if the user is a Flying type or has the Levitate Ability.

dizzypunch.name: Dizzy Punch
dizzypunch.long: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.

laserfocus.name: Laser Focus
laserfocus.desc: Until the end of the next turn, user's moves crit.
laserfocus.long: Until the end of the next turn, the user's attacks will be critical hits.

dragondance.name: Dragon Dance
dragondance.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1.
dragondance.long: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage.

waterfall.name: Waterfall
waterfall.desc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.
waterfall.long: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.

psywave.name: Psywave
psywave.desc: Random damage equal to 0.5×-1.5× user's level.
psywave.long: Deals damage to the target equal to (user's level) × (X + 50) / 100, where X is a random number from 0 to 100, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

camouflage.name: Camouflage
camouflage.desc: Changes user's type by terrain (default Normal).
camouflage.long: The user's type changes based on the battle terrain. Normal type on the regular Wi-Fi terrain, Electric type during Electric Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain. Fails if the user's type cannot be changed or if the user is already purely that type.

batonpass.name: Baton Pass
batonpass.desc: User switches, passing stat changes and more.
batonpass.long: The user is replaced with another Pokemon in its party. The selected Pokemon has the user's stat stage changes transferred to it, as well as the effects of confusion, Aqua Ring, Curse, Dragon Cheer, Embargo, Focus Energy, Gastro Acid, Heal Block, Ingrain, Leech Seed, Lock-On (Mind Reader), Magnet Rise, Perish Song, Power Trick, Telekinesis, and a substitute with its remaining HP. The effect of Gastro Acid is not transferred if the recipient has an Ability that cannot be affected.

guardswap.name: Guard Swap
guardswap.desc: Swaps Defense and Sp. Def changes with target.
guardswap.long: The user swaps its Defense and Special Defense stat stage changes with the target.

magicalleaf.name: Magical Leaf
magicalleaf.desc: This move does not check accuracy.

mistyterrain.name: Misty Terrain
mistyterrain.desc: 5 turns. Can't status,-Dragon power vs grounded.
mistyterrain.long: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Misty Terrain. During the effect, the power of Dragon-type attacks used against grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 0.5 and grounded Pokemon cannot be inflicted with a non-volatile status condition nor confusion. Grounded Pokemon can become affected by Yawn but cannot fall asleep from its effect. Camouflage transforms the user into a Fairy type, Nature Power becomes Moonblast, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to lower Special Attack by 1 stage. Fails if the current terrain is Misty Terrain.

powerswap.name: Power Swap
powerswap.desc: Swaps Attack and Sp. Atk stat stages with target.
powerswap.long: The user swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat stage changes with the target.

recycle.name: Recycle
recycle.desc: Restores the item the user last used.
recycle.long: The user regains the item it last used. Fails if the user is holding an item, if the user has not held an item, if the item was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by a Pokemon with the Pickup Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be regained.

substitute.name: Substitute
substitute.desc: User takes 1/4 its max HP to put in a substitute.
substitute.long: The user takes 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, and puts it into a substitute to take its place in battle. The substitute is removed once enough damage is inflicted on it, if the user switches out or faints, or if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up. Baton Pass can be used to transfer the substitute to an ally, and the substitute will keep its remaining HP. Until the substitute is broken, it receives damage from all attacks made by other Pokemon and shields the user from status effects and stat stage changes caused by other Pokemon. Sound-based moves and Pokemon with the Infiltrator Ability ignore substitutes. The user still takes normal damage from weather and status effects while behind its substitute. If the substitute breaks during a multi-hit attack, the user will take damage from any remaining hits. If a substitute is created while the user is trapped by a binding move, the binding effect ends immediately. Fails if the user does not have enough HP remaining to create a substitute without fainting, or if it already has a substitute.

dazzlinggleam.name: Dazzling Gleam
dazzlinggleam.desc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

teeterdance.name: Teeter Dance
teeterdance.long: Causes the target to become confused.

razorwind.name: Razor Wind
razorwind.desc: Charges, then hits foe(s) turn 2. High crit ratio.
razorwind.long: Has a higher chance for a critical hit. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

drainingkiss.name: Draining Kiss
drainingkiss.desc: User recovers 75% of the damage dealt.
drainingkiss.long: The user recovers 3/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

powdersnow.name: Powder Snow
powdersnow.long: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

heartstamp.name: Heart Stamp
heartstamp.desc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
heartstamp.long: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

faketears.name: Fake Tears
faketears.desc: Lowers the target's Sp. Def by 2.
faketears.long: Lowers the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.

avalanche.name: Avalanche
avalanche.desc: Power doubles if user is damaged by the target.
avalanche.long: Power doubles if the user was hit by the target this turn.

lovelykiss.name: Lovely Kiss
lovelykiss.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.desc: 10% chance to freeze foe(s). Can't miss in Snow.
blizzard.long: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target. If the weather is Snow, this move does not check accuracy.

shockwave.name: Shock Wave
shockwave.desc: This move does not check accuracy.

gigaimpact.name: Giga Impact
gigaimpact.long: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

lavaplume.name: Lava Plume
lavaplume.long: Has a 30% chance to burn the target.

sunnyday.name: Sunny Day
sunnyday.desc: For 5 turns, intense sunlight powers Fire moves.
sunnyday.long: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Sun. The damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Heat Rock. Fails if the current weather is Sun.

hyperbeam.name: Hyper Beam
hyperbeam.long: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

stormthrow.name: Storm Throw
stormthrow.desc: Always results in a critical hit.
stormthrow.long: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.

workup.name: Work Up
workup.desc: Raises the user's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1.
workup.long: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.

ragingbull.name: Raging Bull
ragingbull.desc: Destroys screens. Type depends on user's form.
ragingbull.long: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated. If the user's current form is a Paldean Tauros, this move's type changes to match. Fighting type for Combat Breed, Fire type for Blaze Breed, and Water type for Aqua Breed.

mist.name: Mist
mist.desc: For 5 turns, protects user's party from stat drops.
mist.long: For 5 turns, the user and its party members are protected from having their stat stages lowered by other Pokemon. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

transform.name: Transform
transform.desc: Copies target's stats, moves, types, and Ability.
transform.long: The user transforms into the target. The target's current stats, stat stages, types, moves, Ability, weight, gender, and sprite are copied. The user's level and HP remain the same and each copied move receives only 5 PP, with a maximum of 5 PP each. The user can no longer change formes if it would have the ability to do so. This move fails if it hits a substitute, if either the user or the target is already transformed, or if either is behind an Illusion.

trumpcard.name: Trump Card
trumpcard.desc: More power the fewer PP this move has left.
trumpcard.long: The power of this move is based on the amount of PP remaining after normal PP reduction and the Pressure Ability resolve. 200 power for 0 PP, 80 power for 1 PP, 60 power for 2 PP, 50 power for 3 PP, and 40 power for 4 or more PP.

muddywater.name: Muddy Water
muddywater.desc: 30% chance to lower the foe(s) accuracy by 1.
muddywater.long: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

conversion.name: Conversion
conversion.desc: Changes user's type to match its first move.
conversion.long: The user's type changes to match the original type of the move in its first move slot. Fails if the user cannot change its type, or if the type is one of the user's current types.

sharpen.name: Sharpen
sharpen.long: Raises the user's Attack by 1 stage.

conversion2.name: Conversion 2
conversion2.desc: Changes user's type to resist target's last move.
conversion2.long: The user's type changes to match a type that resists or is immune to the type of the last move used by the target, but not either of its current types. The determined type of the move is used rather than the original type. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the user cannot change its type, or if this move would only be able to select one of the user's current types.

magiccoat.name: Magic Coat
magiccoat.long: Until the end of the turn, the user is unaffected by certain non-damaging moves directed at it and will instead use such moves against the original user. Moves reflected in this way are unable to be reflected again by this or the Magic Bounce Ability's effect. Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes can only be reflected once per side, by the leftmost Pokemon under this or the Magic Bounce Ability's effect. The Lightning Rod and Storm Drain Abilities redirect their respective moves before this move takes effect.

liquidation.name: Liquidation
liquidation.desc: 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.
liquidation.long: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

ironhead.name: Iron Head
ironhead.desc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
ironhead.long: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

skydrop.name: Sky Drop
skydrop.desc: User and foe fly up turn 1. Damages on turn 2.
skydrop.long: This attack takes the target into the air with the user on the first turn and executes on the second. Pokemon weighing 200 kg or more cannot be lifted. On the first turn, the user and the target avoid all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister. The user and the target cannot make a move between turns, but the target can select a move to use. This move cannot damage Flying-type Pokemon. Fails on the first turn if the target is an ally, if the target has a substitute, or if the target is using Bounce, Dig, Dive, Fly, Phantom Force, Shadow Force, or Sky Drop.

block.name: Block
block.desc: Prevents the target from switching out.
block.long: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

sleeptalk.name: Sleep Talk
sleeptalk.desc: User must be asleep. Uses another known move.
sleeptalk.long: One of the user's known moves, besides this move, is selected for use at random. Fails if the user is not asleep. The selected move does not have PP deducted from it, and can currently have 0 PP. This move cannot select Assist, Beak Blast, Belch, Bide, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Focus Punch, Hold Hands, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Uproar, Wicked Torque, or any two-turn move.

snore.name: Snore
snore.desc: User must be asleep. 30% chance to flinch target.
snore.long: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch. Fails if the user is not asleep.

freezedry.name: Freeze-Dry
freezedry.desc: 10% chance to freeze. Super effective on Water.
freezedry.long: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target. This move's type effectiveness against Water is changed to be super effective no matter what this move's type is.

overheat.name: Overheat
overheat.desc: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.
overheat.long: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.

skyattack.name: Sky Attack
skyattack.desc: Charges, then hits turn 2. 30% flinch. High crit.
skyattack.long: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch and a higher chance for a critical hit. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

dragontail.name: Dragon Tail
dragontail.desc: Forces the target to switch to a random ally.
dragontail.long: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target used Ingrain previously, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.

dragonrush.name: Dragon Rush
dragonrush.desc: 20% chance to make the target flinch.
dragonrush.long: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

aurasphere.name: Aura Sphere
aurasphere.desc: This move does not check accuracy.

psystrike.name: Psystrike
psystrike.desc: Damages target based on Defense, not Sp. Def.
psystrike.long: Deals damage to the target based on its Defense instead of Special Defense.

eruption.name: Eruption
eruption.desc: Less power as user's HP decreases. Hits foe(s).
eruption.long: Power is equal to (user's current HP × 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.

defog.name: Defog
defog.desc: -1 evasion; ends user and target hazards/terrain.
defog.long: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 1 stage. If this move is successful and whether or not the target's evasiveness was affected, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard, Mist, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the target's side, and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the user's side. Ignores a target's substitute, although a substitute will still block the lowering of evasiveness. If there is a terrain active and this move is successful, the terrain will be cleared.

psychoshift.name: Psycho Shift
psychoshift.desc: Transfers the user's status ailment to the target.
psychoshift.long: The user's non-volatile status condition is transferred to the target, and the user is then cured. Fails if the user has no non-volatile status condition or if the target already has one.

infestation.name: Infestation
infestation.desc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.
infestation.long: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

spiderweb.name: Spider Web
spiderweb.desc: Prevents the target from switching out.
spiderweb.long: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

stickyweb.name: Sticky Web
stickyweb.desc: Lowers Speed of grounded foes by 1 on switch-in.
stickyweb.long: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, lowering the Speed by 1 stage of each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Fails if the effect is already active on the opposing side. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

toxicthread.name: Toxic Thread
toxicthread.desc: Lowers the target's Speed by 1 and poisons it.
toxicthread.long: Lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage and poisons it.

iondeluge.name: Ion Deluge
iondeluge.desc: Normal moves become Electric type this turn.
iondeluge.long: Causes Normal-type moves to become Electric type this turn. The effect happens after other effects that change a move's type.

wish.name: Wish
wish.desc: Next turn, 50% of the user's max HP is restored.
wish.long: At the end of the next turn, the Pokemon at the user's position has 1/2 of the user's maximum HP restored to it, rounded down. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's position.

ominouswind.name: Ominous Wind
ominouswind.desc: 10% chance to raise all stats by 1 (not acc/eva).
ominouswind.long: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.

cottonspore.name: Cotton Spore
cottonspore.long: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.

cottonguard.name: Cotton Guard
cottonguard.long: Raises the user's Defense by 3 stages.

tearfullook.name: Tearful Look
tearfullook.desc: Lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1.
tearfullook.long: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.

headsmash.name: Head Smash
headsmash.long: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

uturn.name: U-turn
uturn.desc: User switches out after damaging the target.
uturn.long: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

grasswhistle.name: Grass Whistle
grasswhistle.desc: Causes the target to fall asleep.

flowershield.name: Flower Shield
flowershield.desc: Raises Defense by 1 of all active Grass types.
flowershield.long: Raises the Defense of all active Grass-type Pokemon by 1 stage. Fails if there are no active Grass-type Pokemon.

morningsun.name: Morning Sun
morningsun.desc: Heals the user by a weather-dependent amount.
morningsun.long: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Strong Winds or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Heavy Rain, Rain, Sandstorm, or Snow, all rounded half down.

snarl.name: Snarl
snarl.desc: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Sp. Atk by 1.
snarl.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

foulplay.name: Foul Play
foulplay.desc: Uses target's Attack stat in damage calculation.
foulplay.long: Damage is calculated using the target's Attack stat, including stat stage changes. The user's Ability, item, and burn are used as normal.

torment.name: Torment
torment.desc: Target can't select the same move twice in a row.
torment.long: Prevents the target from selecting the same move for use two turns in a row. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.

quash.name: Quash
quash.desc: Forces the target to move last this turn.
quash.long: Causes the target to take its turn after all other Pokemon this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target already moved this turn.

chillyreception.name: Chilly Reception
chillyreception.long: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Snow. The user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members.

hiddenpower.name: Hidden Power
hiddenpower.desc: Varies in type based on the user's IVs.
hiddenpower.long: This move's type depends on the user's individual values (IVs), and can be any type but Fairy and Normal.

painsplit.name: Pain Split
painsplit.desc: Shares HP of user and target equally.
painsplit.long: The user and the target's HP become the average of their current HP, rounded down, but not more than the maximum HP of either one.

twinbeam.name: Twin Beam
twinbeam.long: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

bide.name: Bide
bide.desc: Waits 2 turns; deals double the damage taken.
bide.long: The user spends two turns locked into this move and then, on the second turn after using this move, the user attacks the last Pokemon that hit it, inflicting double the damage in HP it lost to attacks during the two turns. If the last Pokemon that hit it is no longer active, the user attacks a random opposing Pokemon instead. If the user is prevented from moving during this move's use, the effect ends. This move does not check accuracy and does not ignore type immunity.

autotomize.name: Autotomize
autotomize.desc: Raises the user's Speed by 2; user loses 100 kg.
autotomize.long: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages. If the user's Speed was changed, the user's weight is reduced by 100 kg as long as it remains active. This effect is stackable but cannot reduce the user's weight to less than 0.1 kg.

poisontail.name: Poison Tail
poisontail.desc: High critical hit ratio. 10% chance to poison.
poisontail.long: Has a 10% chance to poison the target and a higher chance for a critical hit.

strugglebug.name: Struggle Bug
strugglebug.desc: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Sp. Atk by 1.
strugglebug.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

guardsplit.name: Guard Split
guardsplit.desc: Averages Defense and Sp. Def stats with target.
guardsplit.long: The user and the target have their Defense and Special Defense stats set to be equal to the average of the user and the target's Defense and Special Defense stats, respectively, rounded down. Stat stage changes are unaffected.

powersplit.name: Power Split
powersplit.desc: Averages Attack and Sp. Atk stats with target.
powersplit.long: The user and the target have their Attack and Special Attack stats set to be equal to the average of the user and the target's Attack and Special Attack stats, respectively, rounded down. Stat stage changes are unaffected.

powertrick.name: Power Trick
powertrick.desc: Switches user's Attack and Defense stats.
powertrick.long: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats, and stat stage changes remain on their respective stats. This move can be used again to swap the stats back. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will have its Attack and Defense stats swapped if the effect is active. If the user has its stats recalculated by changing forme while its stats are swapped, this effect is ignored but is still active for the purposes of Baton Pass.

armthrust.name: Arm Thrust
armthrust.long: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

throatchop.name: Throat Chop
throatchop.desc: For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound moves.
throatchop.long: For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound-based moves.

honeclaws.name: Hone Claws
honeclaws.desc: Raises the user's Attack and accuracy by 1.
honeclaws.long: Raises the user's Attack and accuracy by 1 stage.

snatch.name: Snatch
snatch.desc: User steals certain support moves to use itself.
snatch.long: If another Pokemon uses certain non-damaging moves this turn, the user steals that move to use itself. If multiple Pokemon use one of those moves this turn, the applicable moves are all stolen by the first Pokemon in turn order that used this move this turn. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.

beatup.name: Beat Up
beatup.desc: All healthy allies aid in damaging the target.
beatup.long: Hits one time for the user and one time for each unfainted Pokemon without a non-volatile status condition in the user's party. The power of each hit is equal to 5+(X/10), where X is each participating Pokemon's base Attack; each hit is considered to come from the user.

octazooka.name: Octazooka
octazooka.desc: 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.
octazooka.long: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

present.name: Present
present.desc: 40, 80, 120 power, or heals target 1/4 max HP.
present.long: If this move is successful, it deals damage or heals the target. 40% chance for 40 power, 30% chance for 80 power, 10% chance for 120 power, and 20% chance to heal the target by 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down.

steelwing.name: Steel Wing
steelwing.desc: 10% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1.
steelwing.long: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.

comeuppance.name: Comeuppance
comeuppance.desc: If hit by an attack, returns 1.5× damage.
comeuppance.long: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical or special attack this turn equal to 1.5 times the HP lost by the user from that attack, rounded down. If the user did not lose HP from that attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical or special attack this turn.

embargo.name: Embargo
embargo.desc: For 5 turns, the target's item has no effect.
embargo.long: For 5 turns, the target's held item has no effect. An item's effect of causing forme changes is unaffected, but any other effects from such items are negated. During the effect, Fling and Natural Gift are prevented from being used by the target. Items thrown at the target with Fling will still activate for it. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain unable to use items.

sketch.name: Sketch
sketch.desc: Permanently copies the last move target used.
sketch.long: This move is permanently replaced by the last move used by the target. The copied move has the maximum PP for that move. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the user has Transformed, or if the move is Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Dark Void, Hyperspace Fury, Magical Torque, Noxious Torque, Revival Blessing, Sketch, Struggle, Tera Starstorm, Wicked Torque, or any move the user knows.

triplekick.name: Triple Kick
triplekick.desc: Hits 3 times. Each hit can miss, but power rises.
triplekick.long: Hits three times. Power increases to 20 for the second hit and 30 for the third. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit three times.

healbell.name: Heal Bell
healbell.desc: Cures the user's party of all status conditions.
healbell.long: Every Pokemon in the user's party is cured of its non-volatile status condition. Active Pokemon with the Soundproof Ability are not cured, unless they are the user.

milkdrink.name: Milk Drink
milkdrink.desc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.
milkdrink.long: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

sacredfire.name: Sacred Fire
sacredfire.desc: 50% chance to burn the target. Thaws user.
sacredfire.long: Has a 50% chance to burn the target.

weatherball.name: Weather Ball
weatherball.desc: Power doubles and type varies in each weather.
weatherball.long: Power doubles if a weather condition other than Strong Winds is active, and this move's type changes to match. Ice type during Snow, Water type during Heavy Rain or Rain, Rock type during Sandstorm, and Fire type during Intense Sun or Sun. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and uses Weather Ball during Heavy Rain, Rain, Intense Sun, or Sun, this move remains Normal type and does not double in power.

aeroblast.name: Aeroblast
aeroblast.long: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

healblock.name: Heal Block
healblock.desc: For 5 turns, the foe(s) is prevented from healing.
healblock.long: For 5 turns, the target is prevented from restoring any HP as long as it remains active. During the effect, healing and draining moves are unusable, and Abilities and items that grant healing will not heal the user. If an affected Pokemon uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain unable to restore its HP. Pain Split and the Regenerator Ability are unaffected.

energyball.name: Energy Ball
energyball.desc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.
energyball.long: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

shedtail.name: Shed Tail
shedtail.desc: User takes 1/2 its max HP to pass a substitute.
shedtail.long: The user takes 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded up, and creates a substitute that has 1/4 of the user's maximum HP, rounded down. The user is replaced with another Pokemon in its party and the selected Pokemon has the substitute transferred to it. Fails if the user would faint, or if there are no unfainted party members.

rocksmash.name: Rock Smash
rocksmash.desc: 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.
rocksmash.long: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

thief.name: Thief
thief.desc: If the user has no item, it steals the target's.
thief.long: If this attack was successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held item if the user is not holding one. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask held by a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon, respectively, or if the user is one of those species and the target is holding the respective item. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

attract.name: Attract
attract.desc: A target of the opposite gender gets infatuated.
attract.long: Causes the target to become infatuated, making it unable to attack 50% of the time. Fails if both the user and the target are the same gender, if either is genderless, or if the target is already infatuated. The effect ends when either the user or the target is no longer active. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.

naturepower.name: Nature Power
naturepower.desc: Attack depends on terrain (default Tri Attack).
naturepower.long: This move calls another move for use based on the battle terrain. Tri Attack on the regular Wi-Fi terrain, Thunderbolt during Electric Terrain, Moonblast during Misty Terrain, Energy Ball during Grassy Terrain, and Psychic during Psychic Terrain.

mysticalfire.name: Mystical Fire
mysticalfire.desc: 100% chance to lower the target's Sp. Atk by 1.
mysticalfire.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

forcepalm.name: Force Palm
forcepalm.long: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

phantomforce.name: Phantom Force
phantomforce.desc: Disappears turn 1. Hits turn 2. Breaks protection.
phantomforce.long: If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

boomburst.name: Boomburst
boomburst.desc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent Pokemon.

smellingsalts.name: Smelling Salts
smellingsalts.desc: Power doubles if target is paralyzed, and cures it.
smellingsalts.long: Power doubles if the target is paralyzed. If the user has not fainted, the target is cured of paralysis.

headlongrush.name: Headlong Rush
headlongrush.desc: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.
headlongrush.long: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

assist.name: Assist
assist.desc: Uses a random move known by a team member.
assist.long: A random move among those known by the user's party members is selected for use. Does not select Assist, Baneful Bunker, Beak Blast, Belch, Bestow, Blazing Torque, Bounce, Celebrate, Chatter, Circle Throw, Combat Torque, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dig, Dive, Dragon Tail, Endure, Feint, Fly, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, King's Shield, Magical Torque, Mat Block, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Phantom Force, Protect, Rage Powder, Roar, Shadow Force, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sky Drop, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Spiky Shield, Spotlight, Struggle, Switcheroo, Tera Starstorm, Thief, Transform, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wicked Torque.

metalburst.name: Metal Burst
metalburst.desc: If hit by an attack, returns 1.5× damage.
metalburst.long: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical or special attack this turn equal to 1.5 times the HP lost by the user from that attack, rounded down. If the user did not lose HP from that attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical or special attack this turn.

entrainment.name: Entrainment
entrainment.desc: The target's Ability changes to match the user's.
entrainment.long: Causes the target's Ability to become the same as the user's. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, or the same Ability as the user, or if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

flash.name: Flash
flash.long: Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

tailglow.name: Tail Glow
tailglow.desc: Raises the user's Sp. Atk by 3.
tailglow.long: Raises the user's Special Attack by 3 stages.

waterspout.name: Water Spout
waterspout.desc: Less power as user's HP decreases. Hits foe(s).
waterspout.long: Power is equal to (user's current HP × 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.

nobleroar.name: Noble Roar
nobleroar.desc: Lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk by 1.
nobleroar.long: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.

needlearm.name: Needle Arm
needlearm.desc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
needlearm.long: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

powertrip.name: Power Trip
powertrip.desc: + 20 power for each of the user's stat boosts.
powertrip.long: Power is equal to 20+(X × 20), where X is the user's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0.

spikyshield.name: Spiky Shield
spikyshield.desc: Protects from moves. Contact: loses 1/8 max HP.
spikyshield.long: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon making contact with the user lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

magicroom.name: Magic Room
magicroom.desc: For 5 turns, all held items have no effect.
magicroom.long: For 5 turns, the held items of all active Pokemon have no effect. An item's effect of causing forme changes is unaffected, but any other effects from such items are negated. During the effect, Fling and Natural Gift are prevented from being used by all active Pokemon. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

frostbreath.name: Frost Breath
frostbreath.desc: Always results in a critical hit.
frostbreath.long: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.

iceball.name: Ice Ball
iceball.desc: Power doubles with each hit. Repeats for 5 turns.
iceball.long: If this move is successful, the user is locked into this move and cannot make another move until it misses, 5 turns have passed, or the attack cannot be used. Power doubles with each successful hit of this move and doubles again if Defense Curl was used previously by the user. If this move is called by Sleep Talk, the move is used for one turn.

dualwingbeat.name: Dual Wingbeat
dualwingbeat.long: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

fly.name: Fly
fly.desc: Flies up on first turn, then strikes the next turn.
fly.long: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister, and Gust and Twister have doubled power when used against it. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

mistball.name: Mist Ball
mistball.desc: 50% chance to lower the target's Sp. Atk by 1.
mistball.long: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

lusterpurge.name: Luster Purge
lusterpurge.desc: 50% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.
lusterpurge.long: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

simplebeam.name: Simple Beam
simplebeam.long: Causes the target's Ability to become Simple. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Simple, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

originpulse.name: Origin Pulse
originpulse.desc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

precipiceblades.name: Precipice Blades
precipiceblades.desc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

dragonascent.name: Dragon Ascent
dragonascent.desc: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.
dragonascent.long: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

doomdesire.name: Doom Desire
doomdesire.desc: Hits two turns after being used.
doomdesire.long: Deals damage two turns after this move is used. At the end of that turn, the damage is calculated at that time and dealt to the Pokemon at the position the target had when the move was used. If the user is no longer active at the time, damage is calculated based on the user's natural Special Attack stat, types, and level, with no boosts from its held item or Ability. Fails if this move or Future Sight is already in effect for the target's position.

skillswap.name: Skill Swap
skillswap.desc: The user and the target trade Abilities.
skillswap.long: The user swaps its Ability with the target's Ability. Fails if either the user or the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

psychoboost.name: Psycho Boost
psychoboost.desc: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.
psychoboost.long: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.

facade.name: Facade
facade.desc: Power doubles if user is burn/poison/paralyzed.
facade.long: Power doubles if the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned. The physical damage halving effect from the user's burn is ignored.

ragingfury.name: Raging Fury
ragingfury.desc: Lasts 2-3 turns. Confuses the user afterwards.
ragingfury.long: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.

voltswitch.name: Volt Switch
voltswitch.desc: User switches out after damaging the target.
voltswitch.long: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

lunge.name: Lunge
lunge.desc: 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.
lunge.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

aromaticmist.name: Aromatic Mist
aromaticmist.desc: Raises an ally's Sp. Def by 1.
aromaticmist.long: Raises the target's Special Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.

healorder.name: Heal Order
healorder.desc: Heals the user by 50% of its max HP.
healorder.long: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

attackorder.name: Attack Order
attackorder.long: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

defendorder.name: Defend Order
defendorder.desc: Raises the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.
defendorder.long: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

strengthsap.name: Strength Sap
strengthsap.desc: User heals HP=target's Atk stat. Lowers Atk by 1.
strengthsap.long: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage. The user restores its HP equal to the target's Attack stat calculated with its stat stage before this move was used. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down. Fails if the target's Attack stat stage is -6.

frustration.name: Frustration
frustration.long: Power is equal to the greater of ((255 - user's Happiness) × 2/5), rounded down, or 1.

return.name: Return
return.long: Power is equal to the greater of (user's Happiness × 2/5), rounded down, or 1.

chatter.name: Chatter
chatter.long: Has a 100% chance to confuse the target.

confide.name: Confide
confide.desc: Lowers the target's Sp. Atk by 1.
confide.long: Lowers the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

auroraveil.name: Aurora Veil
auroraveil.desc: For 5 turns, damage to allies halved. Snow only.
auroraveil.long: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5× damage from physical and special attacks, or 0.66× damage if in a Double Battle; does not reduce damage further with Reflect or Light Screen. Critical hits ignore this protection. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Brick Break and Psychic Fangs remove the effect before damage is calculated. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails unless the weather is Snow.

rockwrecker.name: Rock Wrecker
rockwrecker.long: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

trickroom.name: Trick Room
trickroom.desc: Goes last. For 5 turns, turn order is reversed.
trickroom.long: For 5 turns, the Speed of every Pokemon is recalculated for the purposes of determining turn order. During the effect, each Pokemon's Speed is considered to be (10000 - its normal Speed), and if this value is greater than 8191, 8192 is subtracted from it. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

aquacutter.name: Aqua Cutter
aquacutter.long: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

sacredsword.name: Sacred Sword
sacredsword.desc: Ignores the target's stat stage changes.
sacredsword.long: Ignores the target's stat stage changes, including evasiveness.

expandingforce.name: Expanding Force
expandingforce.desc: User on Psychic Terrain: 1.5× power, hits foes.
expandingforce.long: If the current terrain is Psychic Terrain and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power multiplied by 1.5.

mysticalpower.name: Mystical Power
mysticalpower.desc: 100% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1.
mysticalpower.long: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.

roaroftime.name: Roar of Time
roaroftime.long: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

spacialrend.name: Spacial Rend
spacialrend.long: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

magmastorm.name: Magma Storm
magmastorm.desc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.
magmastorm.long: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

bodypress.name: Body Press
bodypress.desc: Uses user's Def stat as Atk in damage calculation.
bodypress.long: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes. Other effects that modify the Attack stat are used as normal.

crushgrip.name: Crush Grip
crushgrip.desc: More power the more HP the target has left.
crushgrip.long: Power is equal to 120 × (target's current HP / target's maximum HP), rounded half down, but not less than 1.

shadowforce.name: Shadow Force
shadowforce.desc: Disappears turn 1. Hits turn 2. Breaks protection.
shadowforce.long: If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

lunarblessing.name: Lunar Blessing
lunarblessing.desc: User and allies: healed 1/4 max HP, status cured.
lunarblessing.long: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up, and has its status condition cured.

lunardance.name: Lunar Dance
lunardance.desc: User faints. Next hurt Pkmn is cured, max HP/PP.
lunardance.long: The user faints, and if the Pokemon brought out to replace it does not have full HP or PP, or has a non-volatile status condition, its HP and PP are fully restored along with having any non-volatile status condition cured. The replacement is sent out at the end of the turn, and the healing happens before hazards take effect. This effect continues until a Pokemon that meets any of these conditions switches in at the user's position or gets swapped into the position with Ally Switch. Fails if the user is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party.

takeheart.name: Take Heart
takeheart.desc: Cures user's status, raises Sp. Atk, Sp. Def by 1.
takeheart.long: The user cures its non-volatile status condition. Raises the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage.

heartswap.name: Heart Swap
heartswap.desc: Swaps all stat changes with target.
heartswap.long: The user swaps all its stat stage changes with the target.

darkvoid.name: Dark Void
darkvoid.desc: Darkrai: Causes the foe(s) to fall asleep.
darkvoid.long: Causes the target to fall asleep. This move cannot be used successfully unless the user's current form, while considering Transform, is Darkrai.

seedflare.name: Seed Flare
seedflare.desc: 40% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 2.
seedflare.long: Has a 40% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.

judgment.name: Judgment
judgment.desc: Type varies based on the held Plate.
judgment.long: This move's type depends on the user's held Plate.

vcreate.name: V-create
vcreate.desc: Lowers the user's Defense, Sp. Def, Speed by 1.
vcreate.long: Lowers the user's Speed, Defense, and Special Defense by 1 stage.

searingshot.name: Searing Shot
searingshot.long: Has a 30% chance to burn the target.

heatcrash.name: Heat Crash
heatcrash.desc: More power the heavier the user than the target.
heatcrash.long: The power of this move depends on (user's weight / target's weight), rounded down. Power is equal to 120 if the result is 5 or more, 100 if 4, 80 if 3, 60 if 2, and 40 if 1 or less. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

grassknot.name: Grass Knot
grassknot.desc: More power the heavier the target.
grassknot.long: This move's power is 20 if the target weighs less than 10 kg, 40 if less than 25 kg, 60 if less than 50 kg, 80 if less than 100 kg, 100 if less than 200 kg, and 120 if greater than or equal to 200 kg.

scald.name: Scald
scald.desc: 30% chance to burn the target. Thaws target.
scald.long: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. The target thaws out if it is frozen.

psychicterrain.name: Psychic Terrain
psychicterrain.long: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Psychic Terrain. During the effect, the power of Psychic-type attacks made by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3 and grounded Pokemon cannot be hit by moves with priority greater than 0, unless the target is an ally. Camouflage transforms the user into a Psychic type, Nature Power becomes Psychic, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage. Fails if the current terrain is Psychic Terrain.

secretpower.name: Secret Power
secretpower.desc: Effect varies with terrain. (30% paralysis chance)
secretpower.long: Has a 30% chance to cause a secondary effect on the target based on the battle terrain. Causes paralysis on the regular Wi-Fi terrain, causes paralysis during Electric Terrain, lowers Special Attack by 1 stage during Misty Terrain, causes sleep during Grassy Terrain and lowers Speed by 1 stage during Psychic Terrain.

matblock.name: Mat Block
matblock.desc: Protects allies from damaging attacks. Turn 1 only.
matblock.long: The user and its party members are protected from damaging attacks made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn. Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field, if the user moves last this turn, or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

rockclimb.name: Rock Climb
rockclimb.long: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.

craftyshield.name: Crafty Shield
craftyshield.desc: Protects allies from Status moves this turn.
craftyshield.long: The user and its party members are protected from non-damaging attacks made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

nightdaze.name: Night Daze
nightdaze.desc: 40% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1.
nightdaze.long: Has a 40% chance to lower the target's accuracy by 1 stage.

tailslap.name: Tail Slap
tailslap.long: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

hornleech.name: Horn Leech
hornleech.desc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.
hornleech.long: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

electroweb.name: Electroweb
electroweb.desc: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Speed by 1.
electroweb.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

geargrind.name: Gear Grind
geargrind.long: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

shiftgear.name: Shift Gear
shiftgear.desc: Raises the user's Speed by 2 and Attack by 1.
shiftgear.long: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages and its Attack by 1 stage.

gearup.name: Gear Up
gearup.desc: Raises Atk, Sp. Atk of allies with Plus/Minus by 1.
gearup.long: Raises the Attack and Special Attack of Pokemon on the user's side with the Plus or Minus Abilities by 1 stage.

breakingswipe.name: Breaking Swipe
breakingswipe.desc: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Attack by 1.
breakingswipe.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

watershuriken.name: Water Shuriken
watershuriken.desc: Usually goes first. Hits 2-5 times in one turn.
watershuriken.long: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is an Ash-Greninja with the Battle Bond Ability, this move has a power of 20 and always hits three times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

headcharge.name: Head Charge
headcharge.long: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

firelash.name: Fire Lash
firelash.desc: 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.
firelash.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

fierydance.name: Fiery Dance
fierydance.desc: 50% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1.
fierydance.long: Has a 50% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.

bleakwindstorm.name: Bleakwind Storm
bleakwindstorm.desc: 30% to lower foe(s) Speed by 1. Rain: can't miss.
bleakwindstorm.long: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage. If the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, this move does not check accuracy. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 80%.

wildboltstorm.name: Wildbolt Storm
wildboltstorm.desc: 20% chance to paralyze foe(s). Rain: can't miss.
wildboltstorm.long: Has a 20% chance to paralyze the target. If the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, this move does not check accuracy. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 80%.

fusionflare.name: Fusion Flare
fusionflare.desc: Power doubles if used after Fusion Bolt this turn.
fusionflare.long: Power doubles if the last move used by any Pokemon this turn was Fusion Bolt.

blueflare.name: Blue Flare
blueflare.long: Has a 20% chance to burn the target.

fusionbolt.name: Fusion Bolt
fusionbolt.desc: Power doubles if used after Fusion Flare this turn.
fusionbolt.long: Power doubles if the last move used by any Pokemon this turn was Fusion Flare.

boltstrike.name: Bolt Strike
boltstrike.long: Has a 20% chance to paralyze the target.

sandsearstorm.name: Sandsear Storm
sandsearstorm.desc: 20% chance to burn foe(s). Can't miss in rain.
sandsearstorm.long: Has a 20% chance to burn the target. If the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, this move does not check accuracy. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 80%.

glaciate.name: Glaciate
glaciate.desc: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Speed by 1.
glaciate.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

secretsword.name: Secret Sword
secretsword.desc: Damages target based on Defense, not Sp. Def.
secretsword.long: Deals damage to the target based on its Defense instead of Special Defense.

relicsong.name: Relic Song
relicsong.desc: 10% chance to sleep foe(s). Meloetta transforms.
relicsong.long: Has a 10% chance to cause the target to fall asleep. If this move is successful on at least one target and the user is a Meloetta, it changes to Pirouette Forme if it is currently in Aria Forme, or changes to Aria Forme if it is currently in Pirouette Forme. This forme change does not happen if the Meloetta has the Sheer Force Ability. The Pirouette Forme reverts to Aria Forme when Meloetta is not active.

technoblast.name: Techno Blast
technoblast.desc: Type varies based on the held Drive.
technoblast.long: This move's type depends on the user's held Drive.

powder.name: Powder
powder.desc: If using a Fire move, target loses 1/4 max HP.
powder.long: If the target uses a Fire-type move this turn, it is prevented from executing and the target loses 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. This effect does not happen if the Fire-type move is prevented by Primordial Sea.

partingshot.name: Parting Shot
partingshot.desc: Lowers target's Atk, Sp. Atk by 1. User switches.
partingshot.long: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. If this move is successful, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if the target's Attack and Special Attack stat stages were both unchanged, or if there are no unfainted party members.

kingsshield.name: King's Shield
kingsshield.desc: Protects from damaging attacks. Contact: -1 Atk.
kingsshield.long: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon trying to make contact with the user have their Attack lowered by 1 stage. Non-damaging moves go through this protection. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

topsyturvy.name: Topsy-Turvy
topsyturvy.long: The target's positive stat stages become negative and vice versa. Fails if all of the target's stat stages are 0.

paraboliccharge.name: Parabolic Charge
paraboliccharge.desc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.
paraboliccharge.long: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

electrify.name: Electrify
electrify.desc: Changes the target's move to Electric this turn.
electrify.long: Causes the target's move to become Electric type this turn. Among effects that can change a move's type, this effect happens last. Fails if the target already moved this turn.

flyingpress.name: Flying Press
flyingpress.desc: Combines Flying in its type effectiveness.
flyingpress.long: This move combines Flying in its type effectiveness against the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

fairylock.name: Fairy Lock
fairylock.desc: Prevents all Pokemon from switching next turn.
fairylock.long: Prevents all active Pokemon from switching next turn. A Pokemon can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. Fails if the effect is already active.

forestscurse.name: Forest's Curse
forestscurse.desc: Adds Grass to the target's type(s).
forestscurse.long: Causes the Grass type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Grass type. If Trick-or-Treat adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.

trickortreat.name: Trick-or-Treat
trickortreat.desc: Adds Ghost to the target's type(s).
trickortreat.long: Causes the Ghost type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Ghost type. If Forest's Curse adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.

geomancy.name: Geomancy
geomancy.desc: Charges, then raises SpA, SpD, Spe by 2 turn 2.
geomancy.long: Raises the user's Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 2 stages. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

oblivionwing.name: Oblivion Wing
oblivionwing.desc: User recovers 75% of the damage dealt.
oblivionwing.long: The user recovers 3/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

focusblast.name: Focus Blast
focusblast.desc: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.
focusblast.long: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

coreenforcer.name: Core Enforcer
coreenforcer.desc: Nullifies the foe(s) Ability if the foe(s) move first.
coreenforcer.long: If the user moves after the target, the target's Ability is rendered ineffective as long as it remains active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain under this effect. If the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, this effect does not happen, and receiving the effect through Baton Pass ends the effect immediately.

thousandarrows.name: Thousand Arrows
thousandarrows.desc: Grounds adjacent foes. First hit neutral on Flying.
thousandarrows.long: This move can hit airborne Pokemon, which includes Flying-type Pokemon, Pokemon with the Levitate Ability, Pokemon holding an Air Balloon, and Pokemon under the effect of Magnet Rise or Telekinesis. If the target is a Flying type and is not already grounded, this move deals neutral damage regardless of its other type(s). This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop. If this move hits a target under the effect of Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, the effect ends. If the target is a Flying type that has not used Roost this turn or a Pokemon with the Levitate Ability, it loses its immunity to Ground-type attacks and the Arena Trap Ability as long as it remains active. During the effect, Magnet Rise fails for the target and Telekinesis fails against the target.

thousandwaves.name: Thousand Waves
thousandwaves.desc: Hits adjacent foes. Prevents them from switching.
thousandwaves.long: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

landswrath.name: Land's Wrath
landswrath.desc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

diamondstorm.name: Diamond Storm
diamondstorm.desc: 50% chance to raise user's Defense by 2.
diamondstorm.long: Has a 50% chance to raise the user's Defense by 2 stages.

hyperspacefury.name: Hyperspace Fury
hyperspacefury.desc: Hoopa-U: Lowers user's Def by 1; breaks protect.
hyperspacefury.long: Lowers the user's Defense by 1 stage. This move cannot be used successfully unless the user's current form, while considering Transform, is Hoopa Unbound. If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally.

hyperspacehole.name: Hyperspace Hole
hyperspacehole.desc: Breaks the target's protection for this turn.
hyperspacehole.long: If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally.
