steameruption.name: Steam Eruption
steameruption.desc: 30% chance to burn the target. Thaws target.
steameruption.long: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. The target thaws out if it is frozen.

spiritshackle.name: Spirit Shackle
spiritshackle.desc: Prevents the target from switching out.
spiritshackle.long: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

darkestlariat.name: Darkest Lariat
darkestlariat.desc: Ignores the target's stat stage changes.
darkestlariat.long: Ignores the target's stat stage changes, including evasiveness.

sparklingaria.name: Sparkling Aria
sparklingaria.desc: The target is cured of its burn.
sparklingaria.long: If the user has not fainted, the target is cured of its burn.

beakblast.name: Beak Blast
beakblast.desc: Burns on contact with the user before it moves.
beakblast.long: If the user is hit by a contact move this turn before it can execute this move, the attacker is burned.

icehammer.name: Ice Hammer
icehammer.long: Lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage.

revelationdance.name: Revelation Dance
revelationdance.desc: Type varies based on the user's primary type.
revelationdance.long: This move's type depends on the user's primary type. If the user's primary type is typeless, this move's type is the user's secondary type if it has one, otherwise the added type from Forest's Curse or Trick-or-Treat. This move is typeless if the user's type is typeless alone.

pollenpuff.name: Pollen Puff
pollenpuff.desc: If the target is an ally, heals 50% of its max HP.
pollenpuff.long: If the target is an ally, this move restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down, instead of dealing damage.

banefulbunker.name: Baneful Bunker
banefulbunker.long: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon making contact with the user become poisoned. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

solarblade.name: Solar Blade
solarblade.desc: Charges turn 1. Hits turn 2. No charge in sunlight.
solarblade.long: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Power is halved if the weather is Heavy Rain, Rain, Sandstorm, or Snow and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, the move still requires a turn to charge.

brutalswing.name: Brutal Swing
brutalswing.desc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent Pokemon.

tropkick.name: Trop Kick
tropkick.desc: 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.
tropkick.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

floralhealing.name: Floral Healing
floralhealing.desc: Heals the target by 50% of its max HP.
floralhealing.long: The target restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. If the terrain is Grassy Terrain, the target instead restores 2/3 of its maximum HP, rounded half down.

instruct.name: Instruct
instruct.desc: The target immediately uses its last used move.
instruct.long: The target immediately uses its last used move. Fails if the target has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, if the target is preparing to use Beak Blast, Focus Punch, or Shell Trap, or if the move is Assist, Beak Blast, Belch, Bide, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Focus Punch, Hold Hands, Ice Ball, Instruct, King's Shield, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Obstruct, Outrage, Petal Dance, Rollout, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Thrash, Transform, Uproar, Wicked Torque, any two-turn move, or any recharge move.

firstimpression.name: First Impression
firstimpression.desc: Nearly always goes first. First turn out only.
firstimpression.long: Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field.

shoreup.name: Shore Up
shoreup.desc: User restores 1/2 its max HP; 2/3 in Sandstorm.
shoreup.long: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half down. If the weather is Sandstorm, the user instead restores 2/3 of its maximum HP, rounded half down.

purify.name: Purify
purify.desc: Cures target's status; heals user 1/2 max HP if so.
purify.long: The target is cured if it has a non-volatile status condition. If the target was cured, the user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down.

multiattack.name: Multi-Attack
multiattack.desc: Type varies based on the held Memory.
multiattack.long: This move's type depends on the user's held Memory.

shelltrap.name: Shell Trap
shelltrap.desc: User must take physical damage before moving.
shelltrap.long: Fails unless the user is hit by a physical attack from an opponent this turn before it can execute the move. If the user was hit and has not fainted, it attacks immediately after being hit, and the effect ends. If the opponent's physical attack had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability, it does not count for the purposes of this effect.

zingzap.name: Zing Zap
zingzap.desc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
zingzap.long: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

psychicfangs.name: Psychic Fangs
psychicfangs.desc: Destroys screens, unless the target is immune.
psychicfangs.long: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated.

anchorshot.name: Anchor Shot
anchorshot.desc: Prevents the target from switching out.
anchorshot.long: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

clangingscales.name: Clanging Scales
clangingscales.long: Lowers the user's Defense by 1 stage.

clangoroussoul.name: Clangorous Soul
clangoroussoul.desc: User loses 33% of its max HP. +1 to all stats.
clangoroussoul.long: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage in exchange for the user losing 33% of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed stat stages would not change.

naturesmadness.name: Nature's Madness
naturesmadness.desc: Does damage equal to 1/2 target's current HP.
naturesmadness.long: Deals damage to the target equal to half of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

sunsteelstrike.name: Sunsteel Strike
sunsteelstrike.desc: Ignores the Abilities of other Pokemon.
sunsteelstrike.long: This move and its effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.

moongeistbeam.name: Moongeist Beam
moongeistbeam.desc: Ignores the Abilities of other Pokemon.
moongeistbeam.long: This move and its effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.

speedswap.name: Speed Swap
speedswap.long: The user swaps its Speed stat with the target. Stat stage changes are unaffected.

photongeyser.name: Photon Geyser
photongeyser.desc: Physical if user's Atk > Sp. Atk. Ignores Abilities.
photongeyser.long: This move becomes a physical attack if the user's Attack is greater than its Special Attack, including stat stage changes. This move and its effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.

prismaticlaser.name: Prismatic Laser
prismaticlaser.long: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

fleurcannon.name: Fleur Cannon
fleurcannon.desc: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 2.
fleurcannon.long: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.

spectralthief.name: Spectral Thief
spectralthief.desc: Steals target's boosts before dealing damage.
spectralthief.long: The target's stat stages greater than 0 are stolen from it and applied to the user before dealing damage.

mindblown.name: Mind Blown
mindblown.desc: User loses 50% max HP. Hits adjacent Pokemon.
mindblown.long: Whether or not this move is successful and even if it would cause fainting, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded up, unless the user has the Magic Guard Ability. This move is prevented from executing and the user does not lose HP if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability, or if this move is Fire type and the user is affected by Powder or the weather is Heavy Rain.

plasmafists.name: Plasma Fists
plasmafists.desc: Normal moves become Electric type this turn.
plasmafists.long: If this move is successful, causes Normal-type moves to become Electric type this turn.

doubleironbash.name: Double Iron Bash
doubleironbash.desc: Hits twice. 30% chance to make the target flinch.
doubleironbash.long: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit. Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

drumbeating.name: Drum Beating
drumbeating.desc: 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1.
drumbeating.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

pyroball.name: Pyro Ball
pyroball.desc: 10% chance to burn the target. Thaws user.
pyroball.long: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

courtchange.name: Court Change
courtchange.desc: Swaps user's field effects with the opposing side.
courtchange.long: Switches the Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Spikes, Safeguard, Tailwind, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, Water Pledge, Fire Pledge, Grass Pledge, Sticky Web, Aurora Veil, G-Max Steelsurge, G-Max Cannonade, G-Max Vine Lash, and G-Max Wildfire effects from the user's side to the opposing side and vice versa.

snipeshot.name: Snipe Shot
snipeshot.desc: High critical hit ratio. Cannot be redirected.
snipeshot.long: Has a higher chance for a critical hit. This move cannot be redirected to a different target by any effect.

stuffcheeks.name: Stuff Cheeks
stuffcheeks.desc: Must hold Berry to use. User eats Berry, Def +2.
stuffcheeks.long: This move cannot be selected unless the user is holding a Berry. The user eats its Berry and raises its Defense by 2 stages. This effect is not prevented by the Klutz or Unnerve Abilities, or the effects of Embargo or Magic Room. Fails if the user is not holding a Berry.

jawlock.name: Jaw Lock
jawlock.desc: Prevents both user and target from switching out.
jawlock.long: Prevents the user and the target from switching out. The user and the target can still switch out if either of them is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

tarshot.name: Tar Shot
tarshot.desc: Target gets -1 Spe and becomes weaker to Fire.
tarshot.long: Lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage. Until the target switches out, the effectiveness of Fire-type moves is doubled against it.

gravapple.name: Grav Apple
gravapple.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage. Power is multiplied by 1.5 during Gravity's effect.

appleacid.name: Apple Acid
appleacid.desc: 100% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.
appleacid.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

octolock.name: Octolock
octolock.desc: Traps target, lowers Def and SpD by 1 each turn.
octolock.long: Prevents the target from switching out. At the end of each turn during effect, the target's Defense and Special Defense are lowered by 1 stage. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

teatime.name: Teatime
teatime.desc: All active Pokemon consume held Berries.
teatime.long: All active Pokemon consume their held Berries. This effect is not prevented by substitutes, the Klutz or Unnerve Abilities, or the effects of Embargo or Magic Room. Fails if no active Pokemon is holding a Berry.

magicpowder.name: Magic Powder
magicpowder.desc: Changes the target's type to Psychic.
magicpowder.long: Causes the target to become a Psychic type. Fails if the target is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the target is already purely Psychic type, or if the target is Terastallized.

falsesurrender.name: False Surrender
falsesurrender.desc: This move does not check accuracy.

spiritbreak.name: Spirit Break
spiritbreak.desc: 100% chance to lower the target's Sp. Atk by 1.
spiritbreak.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

obstruct.name: Obstruct
obstruct.desc: Protects from damaging attacks. Contact: -2 Def.
obstruct.long: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon trying to make contact with the user have their Defense lowered by 2 stages. Non-damaging moves go through this protection. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

meteorassault.name: Meteor Assault
meteorassault.long: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

decorate.name: Decorate
decorate.desc: Raises the target's Attack and Sp. Atk by 2.
decorate.long: Raises the target's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages.

noretreat.name: No Retreat
noretreat.desc: Raises all stats by 1 (not acc/eva). Traps user.
noretreat.long: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage, but it becomes prevented from switching out. The user can still switch out if it uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. Fails if the user has already been prevented from switching by this effect.

aurawheel.name: Aura Wheel
aurawheel.long: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage. If the user is a Morpeko in Full Belly Mode, this move is Electric type. If the user is a Morpeko in Hangry Mode, this move is Dark type. This move cannot be used successfully unless the user's current form, while considering Transform, is Full Belly or Hangry Mode Morpeko.

boltbeak.name: Bolt Beak
boltbeak.desc: Power doubles if user moves before the target.
boltbeak.long: Power doubles if the user moves before the target.

fishiousrend.name: Fishious Rend
fishiousrend.desc: Power doubles if user moves before the target.
fishiousrend.long: Power doubles if the user moves before the target.

dragondarts.name: Dragon Darts
dragondarts.desc: Hits twice. Doubles: Tries to hit each foe once.
dragondarts.long: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit. In Double Battles, this move attempts to hit the targeted Pokemon and its ally once each. If hitting one of these Pokemon would be prevented by immunity, protection, semi-invulnerability, an Ability, or accuracy, it attempts to hit the other Pokemon twice instead. If this move is redirected, it hits that target twice.

eternabeam.name: Eternabeam
eternabeam.long: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

wickedblow.name: Wicked Blow
wickedblow.desc: Always results in a critical hit.
wickedblow.long: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.

junglehealing.name: Jungle Healing
junglehealing.desc: User and allies: healed 1/4 max HP, status cured.
junglehealing.long: Each Pokemon on the user's side restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded half up, and has its status condition cured.

thundercage.name: Thunder Cage
thundercage.desc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.
thundercage.long: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

dragonenergy.name: Dragon Energy
dragonenergy.desc: Less power as user's HP decreases. Hits foe(s).
dragonenergy.long: Power is equal to (user's current HP × 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.

psyshieldbash.name: Psyshield Bash
psyshieldbash.desc: 100% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1.
psyshieldbash.long: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.

stoneaxe.name: Stone Axe
stoneaxe.desc: Sets Stealth Rock on the target's side.
stoneaxe.long: If this move is successful, it sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in. Foes lose 1/32, 1/16, 1/8, 1/4, or 1/2 of their maximum HP, rounded down, based on their weakness to the Rock type; 0.25×, 0.5×, neutral, 2×, or 4×, respectively. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

direclaw.name: Dire Claw
direclaw.desc: 50% chance to sleep, poison, or paralyze target.
direclaw.long: Has a 50% chance to cause the target to either fall asleep, become poisoned, or become paralyzed.

barbbarrage.name: Barb Barrage
barbbarrage.desc: 50% psn. 2× power if target already poisoned.
barbbarrage.long: Has a 50% chance to poison the target. Power doubles if the target is already poisoned.

springtidestorm.name: Springtide Storm
springtidestorm.desc: 30% chance to lower the foe(s) Attack by 1.
springtidestorm.long: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

flowertrick.name: Flower Trick
flowertrick.desc: Always results in a critical hit; no accuracy check.
flowertrick.long: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities. This move does not check accuracy.

torchsong.name: Torch Song
torchsong.desc: 100% chance to raise the user's Sp. Atk by 1.
torchsong.long: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.

aquastep.name: Aqua Step
aquastep.desc: 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1.
aquastep.long: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.

skittersmack.name: Skitter Smack
skittersmack.desc: 100% chance to lower target's Sp. Atk by 1.
skittersmack.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

silktrap.name: Silk Trap
silktrap.desc: Protects from damaging attacks. Contact: -1 Spe.
silktrap.long: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon trying to make contact with the user have their Speed lowered by 1 stage. Non-damaging moves go through this protection. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

revivalblessing.name: Revival Blessing
revivalblessing.desc: Revives a fainted Pokemon to 50% HP.
revivalblessing.long: A fainted party member is selected and revived with 1/2 its max HP, rounded down. Fails if there are no fainted party members.

doubleshock.name: Double Shock
doubleshock.desc: User's Electric type: typeless; must be Electric.
doubleshock.long: Fails unless the user is an Electric type. If this move is successful and the user is not Terastallized, the user's Electric type becomes typeless as long as it remains active.

populationbomb.name: Population Bomb
populationbomb.desc: Hits 10 times. Each hit can miss.
populationbomb.long: Hits ten times. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit ten times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move hits four to ten times at random without checking accuracy between hits.

tidyup.name: Tidy Up
tidyup.desc: User +1 Atk, Spe. Clears all substitutes/hazards.
tidyup.long: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage. Removes substitutes from all active Pokemon and ends the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes for both sides.

terrainpulse.name: Terrain Pulse
terrainpulse.desc: User on terrain: power doubles, type varies.
terrainpulse.long: Power doubles if the user is grounded and a terrain is active, and this move's type changes to match. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain.

saltcure.name: Salt Cure
saltcure.desc: Deals 1/8 max HP each turn; 1/4 on Steel, Water.
saltcure.long: Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/4 if the target is Steel or Water type), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.

armorcannon.name: Armor Cannon
armorcannon.desc: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def by 1.
armorcannon.long: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

bitterblade.name: Bitter Blade
bitterblade.desc: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.
bitterblade.long: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

doodle.name: Doodle
doodle.desc: User and ally's Abilities become target's Ability.
doodle.long: The user and its ally's Abilities change to match the target's Ability. Does not change Ability if the user's or its ally's is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, Zero to Hero, or already matches the target. Fails if both the user and its ally's Ability already matches the target, or if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

spicyextract.name: Spicy Extract
spicyextract.desc: Raises target's Atk by 2 and lowers its Def by 2.
spicyextract.long: Raises the target's Attack by 2 stages and lowers its Defense by 2 stages.

luminacrash.name: Lumina Crash
luminacrash.desc: 100% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 2.
luminacrash.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.

gigatonhammer.name: Gigaton Hammer
gigatonhammer.desc: Cannot be selected the turn after it's used.

flipturn.name: Flip Turn
flipturn.desc: User switches out after damaging the target.
flipturn.long: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

spinout.name: Spin Out
spinout.long: Lowers the user's Speed by 2 stages.

mortalspin.name: Mortal Spin
mortalspin.desc: Poisons foes, frees user from hazards/bind/leech.
mortalspin.long: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the effects of Leech Seed and binding moves end for the user, and all hazards are removed from the user's side of the field. Has a 100% chance to poison the target.

lastrespects.name: Last Respects
lastrespects.desc: +50 power for each time a party member fainted.
lastrespects.long: Power is equal to 50+(X × 50), where X is the total number of times any Pokemon has fainted on the user's side, and X cannot be greater than 100.

icespinner.name: Ice Spinner
icespinner.long: Ends the effects of Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain, and Psychic Terrain.

filletaway.name: Fillet Away
filletaway.desc: +2 Attack, Sp. Atk, Speed for 1/2 user's max HP.
filletaway.long: Raises the user's Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by 2 stages in exchange for the user losing 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack, Special Attack, and Speed stat stages would not change.

orderup.name: Order Up
orderup.long: If an ally Tatsugiri has activated its Commander Ability, this move raises the user's Attack by 1 stage if the Tatsugiri is Curly Form, Defense by 1 stage if Droopy Form, or Speed by 1 stage if Stretchy Form. The effect happens even if the Tatsugiri that activated the effect has since fainted.

kowtowcleave.name: Kowtow Cleave
kowtowcleave.desc: This move does not check accuracy.

steelroller.name: Steel Roller
steelroller.desc: Fails if there is no terrain active. Ends the terrain.
steelroller.long: Fails if there is no terrain active. Ends the effects of Electric Terrain, Grassy Terrain, Misty Terrain, and Psychic Terrain.

glaiverush.name: Glaive Rush
glaiverush.desc: User takes sure-hit 2× damage until its next turn.
glaiverush.long: If this move is successful, moves targeted at the user deal double damage and do not check accuracy until the user's next turn.

makeitrain.name: Make It Rain
makeitrain.desc: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk by 1. Hits foe(s).
makeitrain.long: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.

ruination.name: Ruination
ruination.desc: Does damage equal to 1/2 target's current HP.
ruination.long: Deals damage to the target equal to half of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

scaleshot.name: Scale Shot
scaleshot.desc: Hits 2-5 times. User: -1 Def, +1 Spe after last hit.
scaleshot.long: Hits two to five times. Lowers the user's Defense by 1 stage and raises the user's Speed by 1 stage after the last hit. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

collisioncourse.name: Collision Course
collisioncourse.long: Damage is multiplied by 1.3333 if this move is super effective against the target.

electrodrift.name: Electro Drift
electrodrift.long: Damage is multiplied by 1.3333 if this move is super effective against the target.

hydrosteam.name: Hydro Steam
hydrosteam.desc: During Sun: 1.5× damage instead of half.
hydrosteam.long: If the current weather is Sun and the user is not holding Utility Umbrella, this move's damage is multiplied by 1.5 instead of halved for being Water type.

psyblade.name: Psyblade
psyblade.long: If the current terrain is Electric Terrain, this move's power is multiplied by 1.5.

syrupbomb.name: Syrup Bomb
syrupbomb.desc: Target's Speed is lowered by 1 stage for 3 turns.
syrupbomb.long: If this move is successful, it causes the target's Speed to be lowered by 1 stage at the end of each turn for 3 turns.

matchagotcha.name: Matcha Gotcha
matchagotcha.desc: 20% burn. Recovers 50% dmg dealt. Thaws foe(s).
matchagotcha.long: Has a 20% chance to burn the target. The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down. The target thaws out if it is frozen.

ivycudgel.name: Ivy Cudgel
ivycudgel.desc: High critical hit ratio. Type depends on user's form.
ivycudgel.long: Has a higher chance for a critical hit. If the user is an Ogerpon, this move's type changes depending on its form. Water type for Wellspring Mask, Fire type for Hearthflame Mask, and Rock type for Cornerstone Mask.

electroshot.name: Electro Shot
electroshot.desc: Raises Sp. Atk by 1, hits turn 2. Rain: no charge.
electroshot.long: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Raises the user's Special Attack by 1 stage on the first turn. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, the move still requires a turn to charge.

ficklebeam.name: Fickle Beam
ficklebeam.desc: Has a 30% chance this move's power is doubled.

burningbulwark.name: Burning Bulwark
burningbulwark.desc: Protects from damaging attacks. Contact: burn.
burningbulwark.long: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon trying to make contact with the user become burned. Non-damaging moves go through this protection. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
thunderclap.desc: Usually goes first. Fails if target is not attacking.
thunderclap.long: Fails if the target did not select a physical attack, special attack, or Me First for use this turn, or if the target moves before the user.

risingvoltage.name: Rising Voltage
risingvoltage.desc: 2× power if target is grounded in Electric Terrain.
risingvoltage.long: If the current terrain is Electric Terrain and the target is grounded, this move's power is doubled.

tachyoncutter.name: Tachyon Cutter
tachyoncutter.desc: Hits twice. This move does not check accuracy.
tachyoncutter.long: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit. This move does not check accuracy.

terastarstorm.name: Tera Starstorm
terastarstorm.desc: Terapagos-Stellar: Stellar type, hits both foes.
terastarstorm.long: If the user is a Terapagos in Stellar Form, this move's type becomes Stellar, hits all opposing Pokemon, and becomes a physical attack if the user's Attack is greater than its Special Attack, including stat stage changes.

malignantchain.name: Malignant Chain
malignantchain.desc: 50% chance to badly poison the target.
malignantchain.long: Has a 50% chance to badly poison the target.

freezeshock.name: Freeze Shock
freezeshock.long: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

iceburn.name: Ice Burn
iceburn.long: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

lightofruin.name: Light of Ruin
lightofruin.long: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

shadowbone.name: Shadow Bone
shadowbone.desc: 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.
shadowbone.long: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

shellsidearm.name: Shell Side Arm
shellsidearm.desc: 20% psn. Physical+contact if it would be stronger.
shellsidearm.long: Has a 20% chance to poison the target. This move becomes a physical attack that makes contact if the value of ((((2 × the user's level / 5 + 2) × 90 × X) / Y) / 50), where X is the user's Attack stat and Y is the target's Defense stat, is greater than the same value where X is the user's Special Attack stat and Y is the target's Special Defense stat. No stat modifiers other than stat stage changes are considered for this purpose. If the two values are equal, this move chooses a damage category at random.

strangesteam.name: Strange Steam
strangesteam.long: Has a 20% chance to confuse the target.

freezingglare.name: Freezing Glare
freezingglare.long: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

thunderouskick.name: Thunderous Kick
thunderouskick.desc: 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1.
thunderouskick.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

fierywrath.name: Fiery Wrath
fierywrath.desc: 20% chance to make the foe(s) flinch.
fierywrath.long: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.

eeriespell.name: Eerie Spell
eeriespell.desc: Removes 3 PP from the target's last move.
eeriespell.long: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the target loses 3 PP from its last move.

snaptrap.name: Snap Trap
snaptrap.desc: Traps and damages the target for 4-5 turns.
snaptrap.long: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

surgingstrikes.name: Surging Strikes
surgingstrikes.desc: Always results in a critical hit. Hits 3 times.
surgingstrikes.long: Hits three times. This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.

glaciallance.name: Glacial Lance
glaciallance.desc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

astralbarrage.name: Astral Barrage
astralbarrage.desc: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

chloroblast.name: Chloroblast
chloroblast.long: If this move is successful, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded up, unless the user has the Magic Guard or Rock Head Abilities.

infernalparade.name: Infernal Parade
infernalparade.desc: 30% burn. 2× power if target is already statused.
infernalparade.long: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. Power doubles if the target has a non-volatile status condition.

ceaselessedge.name: Ceaseless Edge
ceaselessedge.desc: Sets a layer of Spikes on the opposing side.
ceaselessedge.long: If this move is successful, it sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. A maximum of three layers may be set, and opponents lose 1/8 of their maximum HP with one layer, 1/6 of their maximum HP with two layers, and 1/4 of their maximum HP with three layers, all rounded down. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

victorydance.name: Victory Dance
victorydance.desc: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Speed by 1.
victorydance.long: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.

bittermalice.name: Bitter Malice
bittermalice.desc: 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1.
bittermalice.long: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

esperwing.name: Esper Wing
esperwing.desc: 100% chance to raise user Speed by 1. High crit.
esperwing.long: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage and a higher chance for a critical hit.

shelter.name: Shelter
shelter.long: Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.

mountaingale.name: Mountain Gale
mountaingale.desc: 30% chance to make the target flinch.
mountaingale.long: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

triplearrows.name: Triple Arrows
triplearrows.long: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage, a 30% chance to make it flinch, and a higher chance for a critical hit.

bloodmoon.name: Blood Moon
bloodmoon.desc: Cannot be selected the turn after it's used.
